**Job Description**
**About the Function:**
Legal at Diageo is about more than handling risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.
  
  
Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.
  
  
It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only authorities in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lead the operation and continuous improvement of Business Integrity’s Know Your Business Partner (KYBP) / Business Partner Integrity programme, helping ensure that integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners are identified, assessed, mitigated and monitored through a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach aligned to the Spirit of Integrity Framework.
  
  
The role will drive transformation and process improvement across the end-to-end KYBP lifecycle, working across Business Integrity and with Procurement, Commercial, D&T and other enterprise partners to simplify and strengthen processes, improve user experience, and make effective use of data, technology and automation. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, the role will also help find opportunities to align approaches, capabilities and ways of working across the function where relevant.
  
  
More broadly, the role will provide flexible project, analytical and operational capability across the Compliance Operations portfolio, supporting wider priorities and continuous improvement as the BI programme evolves.
  
  

* Lead the KYBP / Business Partner Integrity programme: Lead the operation and continuous improvement of the KYBP element of the Spirit of Integrity Framework, ensuring a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, approving and monitoring integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners.
* Drive KYBP transformation and end-to-end process excellence: Lead transformation and improvement across the end-to-end KYBP / KYC / TPRM lifecycle, working across Procurement, Commercial, OpCoP, the TPRM Control Tower, Legal, Finance, D&T and markets to simplify processes, strengthen handoffs and accountabilities, improve user experience and embed scalable and sustainable ways of working. Work with Legal Operations and other partners where there are opportunities to demonstrate common approaches to process improvement, service delivery or transformation.
* Maintain KYBP standards, methodology and risk-based decision-making: Develop and maintain the standards, procedures, playbooks and methodology supporting KYBP, including risk segmentation, due diligence requirements, screening, red flags, issue, mitigation and ongoing monitoring. Work with relevant risk-domain SMEs to ensure appropriate coverage of bribery and corruption, sanctions, money laundering, failure to prevent fraud, facilitation of tax evasion and other relevant integrity risks.
* Strengthen data, technology, monitoring and programme effectiveness: Use data, insight and monitoring to understand the effectiveness of the KYBP programme and find opportunities for continuous improvement. Define business requirements and work with D&T, Compliance Operations and other partners to improve systems, workflows, automation and AI-enabled capabilities supporting business partner integrity. Support complex or non-standard business relationships and strategic transactions, including relevant joint venture and M&A due diligence, risk assessment, mitigation and integration requirements.
* Support delivery across the Legal and Compliance Operations portfolio: Provide flexible analytical, project and operational support across the wider Compliance Operations agenda, responding to evolving priorities and opportunities to strengthen the BI programme. This may include projects and initiatives across Speak Up and breach management, BI controls, policy governance, training and engagement, risk assessment and monitoring, data and analytics, regulatory developments, external benchmarking and other elements of the Spirit of Integrity Framework. Provide appropriate resilience and cover for key Compliance Operations activities as required. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, give to cross-functional initiatives where relevant to the role's expertise and capabilities.

**Key Competencies**

* Business Partner Risk and Compliance Judgement: Strong understanding of third-party and business partner integrity risk, with the ability to apply risk-based and proportionate judgement across due diligence, screening, mitigation, issue and ongoing monitoring.
* Process Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement: Understands how processes, systems, data and controls connect, and identifies practical opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and continuously improve end-to-end ways of working.
* Problem Solving, Delivery and Partner Management: Brings structure to complex, cross-functional problems, handles projects and priorities effectively, and works collaboratively across stakeholders to translate requirements and ideas into practical, sustainable outcomes

* Relevant experience in ethics and compliance, third-party risk management, KYC/KYBP, consulting, transformation or a related field.

jobs.title: Poultry Nutrition Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

Protect yourself against recruitment fraud. Cargill will not ask for money, processing fees, or bank information as a pre-condition of employment. We are aware that unauthorized individuals may have posed as Cargill recruiters, made contact about job opportunities, and extended job offers via text message, instant message or chat rooms. To ensure a job posting is legitimate, it must be listed on the Cargill.com/Careers website. Learn how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud

jobs.description:
**About Kapiva**

At Kapiva, we're on a mission to bring the wisdom of Ayurveda into the everyday lives of modern consumers. We combine time-tested Indian wellness traditions with scientific innovation to create nutrition-led health solutions that are natural, effective, and convenient.

Our portfolio spans multiple wellness categories including digestion, weight management, diabetes, cholesterol, skin & hair, immunity, and more. Kapiva has built a strong presence across leading e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa and BigBasket, while rapidly expanding its offline footprint through leading retail partners including Reliance Retail, Nature's Basket and Noble Plus.

Backed by leading consumer-focused investors including OrbiMed, Fireside Ventures, Vertex Ventures, 3one4 Capital, Sharp Ventures and Jetty Ventures, Kapiva is entering an exciting phase of scale. As we continue to grow, we are building people practices that are as innovative, agile and consumer-centric as the business itself.

**About the Role:**

This role demands a candidate with a strong foundation in legal principles, excellent drafting and negotiation skills, and the ability to assist in managing contracts, litigation, regulatory compliance, and intellectual property matters effectively in a dynamic business environment.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and review a variety of commercial contracts, including NDAs, manufacturing agreements, vendor agreements, service agreements, and other business-related documents.
* Assist in drafting and reviewing responses to legal notices, plaints, written statements and support dispute resolution processes. Coordinate with external counsels on litigation matters and ensure timely updates and follow-ups and maintain the litigation tracker.
* Support the filing and management of trademarks, copyrights, and patents to ensure all intellectual property of the company are safeguarded.
* Provide legal support on new product launches, collaborations, and campaigns, ensuring compliance with applicable laws (FSSAI, AYUSH, ASCI, Consumer Protection, etc.).
* Maintain organized and updated records of executed contracts, legal opinions, and other relevant documents.
* Assist in researching and reviewing new legal and regulatory developments to ensure compliance.
* Liaise with authorities for compliance queries, show-cause responses, and regulatory submissions.
* Lead periodic training sessions for internal teams on compliance and contractual awareness.
* Manage end-to-end company secretarial compliance under the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable Secretarial Standards, including convening and minuting Board, Committee and General Meetings, maintaining statutory registers, and ensuring timely ROC/MCA filings.
* Support fundraising and other capital transactions (private placements, preferential allotments, rights/bonus issues, ESOP grants and share transfers), including term sheet and SHA/SSA review, investor due diligence, closing documentation, allotments, cap table maintenance and FEMA/RBI reporting (FC-GPR, FC-TRS).
* Track and operationalise investor rights under the Shareholders’ Agreement and Articles of Association, including reserved matter/affirmative vote approvals and investor information rights.

**Basic Qualifications and required skill-set**

* Graduate in law with a legal experience of 4-5 years working in a law firm or in a corporate legal department as an in-house counsel preferably in the FMCG industry.
* Qualified Company Secretary (Associate/Fellow member of ICSI) with hands-on company secretarial experience in both a startup/VC-funded company and a listed company.
* Demonstrated active participation in fundraising rounds, from term sheet through closing, including due diligence, transaction documents, allotment and post-closing regulatory filings.
* Willingness to stay updated on evolving legal and regulatory landscapes and apply learnings in the organization.
* Partner with business, marketing, and operations teams to proactively identify legal risks and provide pragmatic solutions.
* A team player who can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across teams.

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

Leads AMEA Consumer Technical Insights for the Cereal category to shape and align Sensory and Consumer learning plans related to commercial or technical platform to ensure successful Innovation / Renovation launches to be implemented in 9 business units of this region (Australia, Japan, Korea, India, SEA, South Africa, Turkey & Egypt). Ensure the correct translation of consumer insights into technical brief for new products that will drive user experience superiority and top-line revenue growth.

Guides and accelerates learning on Product and Consumer Understanding and integrating knowledge collectively from Sensory, Consumer and Shelf-Life research. Applies psychometric, statistical, and other sensory methodologies which lead to reliable business decisions and competitive advantage.

  

This position is based out of Bangalore, India. Estimated travel is 20%.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Cross-Functional Team Collaboration** - Partner with cross functional product development teams to meet project goals. This position works closely with product development, marketing, marketing research, statistics, quality assurance, manufacturing and other Consumer Technical Insights (CTI) scientists. Together you will focus on the project objectives while developing customized research plans to meet objectives, conduct research, report and interpret results. Mentor junior CTI scientists.
* **Test Execution and Methodology**  Develop and align complex research plans, execute studies, interpret data, and report results a variety of stakeholders. You will use risk-based assessments to design learning plans that include descriptive analysis, discrimination testing, consumer research, and shelf-life research based in statistical design. Partner with CTI staff, guiding the development and implementation of new testing methodologies / opportunities for research.
* **Technical Recommendations** - Provide technical recommendations based on your knowledge of consumer psychology and behavioural science, food chemistry, packaging, statistics and product development as it applies to sensory and consumer research.
* **Industry Knowledge** As a CTI scientist, you will need to keep current with advancements in sensory and consumer research, ingredient technology and food science. Take advantage of technical journals, attending technical presentations by suppliers, and networking with experts in the field.

  

**Job Specifications / Qualifications**

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Sensory Science, Food Science, Consumer Science, Psychology, Statistics, or related discipline; Master's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

**Knowledge / Experience**

* Typically 5+ years relevant R&D (Masters 3 + years), technical, manufacturing, or innovation experience.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**WHO WE ARE**
We're one of the world's largest food and beverage companies and a trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods, earning us a spot on 97% of American household tables. As the guardians of our beloved brands and the creators of innovative products, we're dedicated To Sustainably Grow by Delighting More Consumers Globally.
  
  
Today, The Kraft Heinz Company is building a new legacy by investing in a robust Digital infrastructure to revolutionize the food and beverage industry. We are on a journey to create a digitally-powered, agile-enterprise – all while honoring a 150-year heritage and a portfolio of 200 iconic brands. At the heart of this journey is our ambition to create an environment where powerful AI solutions augment humans and where small mission-based teams relentlessly pursue tangible solutions for our consumers, customers, and the enterprise.
  
  
That ambition requires us to create a modern cloud and data ecosystem - a one of its kind that becomes the neural network of our company. We want you to bring your tech-self to us. We use Python, R, Spark, React, Tableau, Snowflake, Azure, and others to solve our business challenges. You can look forward to high-impact, no bureaucracy, entrepreneurial work – done in small teams – and a unique opportunity to create something bold, something awesome, something inventive -- and something globally impactful.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a Data Scientist you will be a core member of one of our nimble, cross-functional teams – disrupting from inside of a global powerhouse. You will help build our next generation of advanced analytics products using AI, Data Science, and Machine Learning. Examples of problems you will solve include helping R&D determine the next generation of household products, revolutionizing consumer engagement with personally relevant content, and reinventing our supply chain to eliminate food waste. Furthermore, you will:
  
  

* Deliver systematic approaches and integrating work into products and tools with a trailblazing team of data engineers, analysts, developers, and sometimes chefs.
* Create repeatable, interpretable, dynamic, scalable models as the heart of new statistical products.
* Engineer new features by using your business acumen to improve analytical models.
* Collaborate to refine best practices and deploy best-in-class solutions.

**Who You Are**

* You have a Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or Statistics with 2-5 years of experience.
* You have expertise in Python and/or R as well as SQL and are eager to learn other languages.
* You are proficient in machine learning to deliver clustering, time series, classification, regression, anomaly detection, simulation, and optimization queries.
* You have experience in marketing analytics or root cause analysis

**We're accelerating our ambition to become a best-in-class Digital leader by making data-driven investments that drive smarter business decisions. As the guardians of 200 beloved brands and the creators of innovative products, we're dedicated To Sustainably Grow by Delighting More Consumers Globally. What we build today helps bring joy to customers, consumers, and communities around the world tomorrow. Here at Kraft Heinz, we're not afraid to challenge the status quo. We are bold. We embrace new ideas. We value diverse perspectives. And we dare to do better every single day. We reward courage in the face of uncertainty. And every day, we are transforming our industry. We are creating the future of food, and we invite you to join us.**

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales) – Food Supply Chain Traceability
jobs.description:
**Bengaluru · Hybrid · 2–5 years**

Help India's food and agri companies, from FMCG majors to seafood and meat exporters, trace every unit from farm and factory to shelf. As our first-line technical expert in sales, you'll turn the real-world complexity of factories and warehouses into traceability solutions that executives buy and operators actually use.

**About Tralexho**

Tralexho is a patented Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform for the food and agri supply chain, from raw material and processing to warehousing, distribution and the end consumer. Customers use us to cut losses and counterfeits, recall with precision, and comply from day one with GS1, HACCP, USFDA FSMA 204, EUDR and other standards.

We won the
**MoFPI National Award 2025 for Food Safety & Traceability**
, were shortlisted in
**APEDA's Business Challenge 2026 for export-enabling technology**
, and were named to
**Forbes India DGEMS Select 200**
. We co-authored the
**BIS traceability standard for India**
, are part of NVIDIA Inception, and run AI traceability research with ICAR-CIFT and KUFOS.
*Designed in India, designed for the world.*

**The role**

You'll join the revenue team, reporting to the Head of Sales, and own the technical side of every deal: discovery, demo, proof-of-concept and handover to implementation. You'll work with Indian enterprises serving the domestic market and with exporters selling into the US, EU and beyond.

**What you'll do**

* Run technical discovery with plant heads, quality and supply-chain leaders, and IT, and map the customer's current flows of material, data and systems
* Deliver demos tailored to the customer's own products, lines and warehouses
* Design and run PoCs with product and engineering: scope them, set success criteria, deploy and present the results
* Specify and configure sensors and scanners (barcode/QR, RFID, environmental sensors) for PoCs and deployments, and work with hardware partners on the shop floor
* Answer integration, data and security questions (ERP/WMS, APIs, device connectivity) and compliance questions (FSMA 204, EUDR, GS1, HACCP)
* Write solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners
* Bring field insight back to product so it shapes what we build next

**Your first 90 days**

* **30 days:**
  Know the platform and our standard hardware set well enough to demo it end to end, and shadow live customer engagements
* **60 days:**
  Run discovery and demos on your own
* **90 days:**
  Lead a PoC, including on-site device setup, from scoping to customer sign-off

**Must-haves**

* 2–5 years (career breaks included) in B2B SaaS pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting
* A solid grasp of SaaS architecture, APIs and data integration
* Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical buyers, and clear writing for proposals and RFPs

**Nice-to-haves**

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.

jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

* Drive expansion of the Jabsons General Trade footprint across the East & South Zone, including appointing distributors in under-penetrated states and towns and adapting the GTM approach to regional market dynamics.

* **Sales Achievement:** Primary and secondary sales vs. monthly and quarterly targets (value and volume), and growth over the same period last year, tracked state-wise and distributor-wise.

* **Field Force Productivity:** Productive calls %, lines per call, and average bill value per outlet.
* **Range Selling & New Launches:** Outlet-level distribution of focus SKUs and new launches across categories (peanuts, namkeen, chana, dry fruits).
* **Fill Rate & Order Servicing:** Distributor fill rate and secondary order fill rate within agreed norms.
* **Channel Partner Infrastructure, Investment & Hygiene:** Effectiveness of each distributors infrastructure (warehouse space, delivery vehicles, dedicated salesmen and DMS) against the coverage plan; partner investment in stock and working capital commensurate with business size, with healthy ROI; and operational hygiene, including stock within norms, FIFO and expiry management, accurate DMS data, and timely, documented claim settlement.
* **Sales Returns:** Returns / replacements kept within 2% of sales, with proactive management of near-expiry stock.
* **Trade Spend Effectiveness:** Scheme spend within budget as % of sales, and incremental sales delivered per scheme.

**Designation:** DGM/GM Biotech

  

**Job Descriptions**

The General Manager/DG,, Biotech Centre, Kumar Organic Products Limited is responsible for leading the Biotech team (which includes R&D, Pilot plant, QC-Micro) in Jigani, Bangalore to invent, develop, and commercialize new active cosmetic ingredients, innovative compounds and process technology aligned with the needs of KOPL business.

  

Develop and implement process technology improvements in Kumar

Secure and protect intellectual property assets.

Co-ordinate new compound development and scale-up.

Identify distinctive raw material suppliers for Biotech Products (with purchase department)

Provide a responsive Biotech Centres presence for the customers. Manage KOPL Biotech Centres capital and expense budgets

Take leadership in outsourcing (manufacturing) of products developed by Biotech Centre and increase the revenue.

Lead the R&D Team and development of new Molecules.

Bio transfer, Gene synthesis

* Able to lead, develop and commercialize various bio-based ingredients by processes of fermentation & biotransformation for cosmetics & personal care industries.
* Screening capabilities (enzymes, microorganisms)

Design capabilities.

**Team:** Biotechnology Scientists, Research Associates, Process Development Scientists, Analytical Support and Technical Staff

  

Position Purpose

To lead the Biotechnology R&D function for development, optimization, scale-up and commercialization of biotechnology-based processes for APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, specialty chemicals and other value-added products.

The position will be responsible for converting scientific concepts and laboratory processes into commercially viable, robust, safe, scalable and cost-effective manufacturing processes.

The role will also drive innovation through fermentation, microbial biotechnology, enzymatic transformation, biocatalysis, strain improvement, process intensification and sustainable manufacturing technologies.

  

Key Responsibilities

A. R&D Strategy and Technology Development

* Develop and execute the company's 35-year biotechnology R&D strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Identify new opportunities in fermentation, biocatalysis, enzymatic synthesis, microbial conversion and sustainable chemical manufacturing.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their technical and commercial feasibility.
* Build internal biotechnology capabilities and technology platforms.
* Establish appropriate project stage-gate and technical review systems.

  

Product and Process Development

* Lead biotechnology process development from laboratory proof-of-concept through pilot and commercial scale.
* Develop and optimize fermentation and biotransformation processes.
* Optimize media, feed strategy, inoculum, fermentation parameters, reaction conditions and downstream recovery.
* Establish robust process parameters and operating ranges.
* Improve yield, productivity, conversion, purity, cycle time and process consistency.
* Develop processes capable of meeting required product quality specifications.

  

Scale-Up and Commercialization

* Lead scale-up from laboratory to pilot and commercial manufacturing.
* Define scale-up criteria and critical process parameters.
* Work closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, Analytical R&D and EHS teams.
* Support pilot and commercial batches.
* Troubleshoot process and manufacturing problems.
* Lead technology transfer and process validation support.
* Ensure successful implementation of developed processes at manufacturing sites.

  

Process Economics and Cost Optimization

* Develop techno-economic evaluations for new biotechnology processes.
* Identify major cost drivers and opportunities for cost reduction.
* Drive reduction in raw-material consumption, solvent usage, utilities, waste generation and cycle time.
* Establish target cost of goods for new processes.
* Deliver measurable manufacturing cost improvements through biotechnology/process innovation.

  

E. Innovation and Intellectual Property

* Identify opportunities for patents and proprietary process technologies.
* Work with the IP/legal team on patentability and freedom-to-operate assessments.
* Generate process know-how and protect critical technical knowledge.
* Maintain awareness of competitor technologies and industry developments.
* Build a pipeline of differentiated biotechnology technologies.

  

F. R&D Project Management

* Establish project objectives, milestones, timelines, resources and budgets.
* Manage multiple R&D projects simultaneously.
* Conduct periodic technical and management reviews.
* Identify technical risks and establish mitigation plans.
* Ensure timely completion of development milestones.
* Prepare technical reports and management presentations.

  

G. Quality, Regulatory and EHS

* Ensure R&D activities comply with applicable GMP, quality, EHS and biosafety requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and traceability of development activities.
* Support regulatory submissions and technical responses where required.
* Ensure safe handling of microorganisms, enzymes, chemicals and biological materials.
* Promote safe-by-design approaches during process development.

  

H. Team Leadership

* Build and lead a high-performance biotechnology R&D team.
* Recruit, train and develop scientists and technical personnel.
* Establish technical competency and career-development plans.
* Mentor scientists in experimental design, troubleshooting and scientific decision-making.
* Develop succession plans for critical technical positions.
* Promote collaboration between R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Commercial functions.

  

I. External Collaboration

* Identify and manage collaborations with universities, research institutes, CROs, technology providers and biotechnology companies.
* Evaluate external technologies and licensing opportunities.
* Establish partnerships for specialized technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Represent the company at relevant technical forums and industry conferences.

  

4. Key Interfaces

The position will work closely with:

5. Qualification

**Essential:**

6. Experience

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI HYD 13 SEZ - H84

**Role Purpose**
SymphonyAI is seeking a Functional Consultant specialising in sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, transaction monitoring, and broader financial crime compliance. This is a dual-mandate role: trusted advisor to financial institutions on regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and operating model — and hands-on practitioner who personally configures, tunes, and optimises SymphonyAI solutions on live project engagements.
  
  
This is not an advisory-only position. A significant portion of time is spent in the product: calibrating thresholds, optimising matching logic, and reducing false positives — alongside leading workshops, shaping solution designs, and challenging client thinking with an AI-first mindset.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Hands-On Configuration, Tuning & Optimisation**

* Personally configure, tune, and optimise SymphonyAI screening and financial crime solutions on client projects: threshold calibration, matching logic, segmentation, list management, and false-positive reduction.
* Design and run testing and validation exercises that demonstrably improve detection quality and operational efficiency; analyse system performance and alert outcomes to drive improvements.
* Deliver implementation workstreams end to end: process design, configuration, controls testing, and user training.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to feed field insight into product innovation.

**Client Advisory & Consulting**

* Run workshops and discovery sessions to gather requirements, define use cases, and align solutions to client priorities, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations.
* Translate requirements into functional solution designs, workflows, and implementation recommendations; conduct gap analyses and remediation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor across client Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams — challenging existing methodologies to drive better outcomes.
* Advise customers on applying predictive AI, generative AI, and automation to improve screening accuracy, reduce false positives, and lift investigator productivity.

**Practice Development**

* Contribute to the Financial Crime Compliance Centre of Excellence: tuning methodologies, playbooks, and accelerators.
* Produce high-quality functional documentation, tuning reports, and implementation guidance; mentor junior consultants.

**Requirements**
**Must-Have**

* Demonstrable hands-on experience configuring, tuning, calibrating, and optimising financial crime or screening solutions — candidates must evidence tuning work personally executed, not overseen.
* 8+ years in financial crime compliance, sanctions, AML/KYC, or screening — in financial institutions, RegTech vendors, or professional services.
* Deep knowledge of end-to-end financial crime processes (onboarding, KYC/KYB, CDD/EDD, screening, monitoring, investigations, SAR/STR) and of typologies, evasion techniques, and detection methodologies.
* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (e.g. FATF, FCA, FinCEN, EU AMLD/AMLR, CBUAE) and of screening data providers such as World-Check (LSEG) and Dow Jones.
* Strong consulting presence: proven experience running workshops and engaging senior compliance, risk, operations, and technology stakeholders up to C-suite; excellent communication and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with SQL and data analysis for tuning and compliance insight (e.g. Power BI, Alteryx, or equivalent).

**Preferred**

* Experience with screening/monitoring platforms such as SymphonyAI NetReveal, Fircosoft, SAS, or equivalent; exposure to AI-enabled compliance technologies.
* Professional certifications: CAMS, CAMI, or ICA/MOET AML/CFT.
* Cloud SaaS implementation experience; exposure to transaction monitoring model tuning or fraud detection.
* Background in RegTech, Big 4 / specialised compliance consulting, or financial crime transformation programmes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Delivery: on-time, on-scope, on-budget engagements; billable utilisation ≥ 80%.
* Tuning outcomes: measurable improvements in detection effectiveness and false-positive reduction.
* Client satisfaction: > 90% satisfaction; positive feedback on both advisory expertise and hands-on delivery.
* Practice & quality: contribution to CoE methodologies and playbooks; adherence to SymphonyAI delivery standards.

**Reporting Line**

* Reports to: Head of Professional Services EMEA
* Collaborates with: Product, Engineering, Data Science, Delivery Operations, Sales, and offshore delivery partners. May lead junior consultants on projects.

**About Us**
**What SymphonyAI Offers**

* Tier-1 global financial institutions, transformational screening programmes, and genuine hands-on ownership of tuning outcomes on a market-leading AI SaaS platform.
* A role in building the Financial Crime Compliance Centre of Excellence, with global exposure across EMEA, Americas, and APAC, hybrid flexibility, and competitive compensation.

jobs.title: Manager - Quality Control with Inorganic Chemical Producers
jobs.description:
**Job Profile:**

**Laboratory Setup and Commissioning**

* Establish and operationalize the QC laboratory for the new plant.
* Identify, plan, and install required laboratory equipment, instruments, glassware, chemicals, and utilities.
* Support qualification, calibration, and validation of laboratory instruments and testing systems.
* Develop laboratory layout, workflow, sample handling systems, and storage arrangements for safe and efficient operation.
* Ensure the laboratory is designed and run in accordance with safety norms relevant to hazardous chemical handling.

**Laboratory Management**

* Manage day-to-day laboratory operations to ensure timely and accurate testing.
* Maintain laboratory equipment in working condition through calibration, preventive maintenance, and vendor coordination.
* Monitor inventory of chemicals, reagents, glassware, standards, consumables, and spare parts to prevent disruption.
* Ensure proper housekeeping, storage, labelling, and disposal practices in the laboratory.
* Control laboratory records, test reports, logbooks, and retention samples systematically.

**Testing and Quality Decision-Making**

* Conduct, review, and approve testing of Raw Materials (RM), Work-in-Progress (WiP), Finished Goods (FG), Packing Materials.
* Release or reject materials based on specifications and test results.
* Ensure timely availability of test results to production, stores, and dispatch functions.
* Monitor conformance to product specifications, internal standards, and customer requirements.
* Investigate out-of-specification (OOS), abnormal trends, and deviations, and recommend corrective actions.

**Method Development, Standardization, and Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain specifications, test methods, standard operating procedures, formats, and work instructions for all QC activities.
* Standardise test methods for raw materials, intermediates, finished products, and packing materials.
* Ensure proper documentation of sampling, testing, approvals, rejections, deviations, and retest requirements.
* Maintain certificate of analysis formats and related quality records.
* Support creation and upkeep of documentation required for certifications, audits, and customer requirements.

**Quality Systems and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company quality standards, statutory requirements, and applicable good laboratory practices.
* Support implementation and maintenance of quality management systems.
* Participate in internal audits, customer audits, and third-party inspections.
* Ensure laboratory readiness for audits through proper records, traceability, and system discipline.
* Support non-conformance reporting, CAPA closure, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Coordination with Plant Functions**

* Work closely with production, stores, procurement, maintenance, and dispatch teams for smooth material flow and quality control.
* Coordinate sampling plans and test priorities in line with production schedules and dispatch timelines.
* Provide timely feedback to production on process deviations and product quality issues.
* Coordinate with procurement for quality issues related to incoming raw materials and vendor performance.

**Safety and Risk Control**

* Ensure strict adherence to safety practices in the laboratory, especially considering hazardous raw materials.
* Train staff on safe handling of chemicals, use of PPE, emergency response, spill control, and waste disposal.
* Ensure safe storage and handling of reagents, samples, and hazardous substances.
* Work closely with EHS and plant leadership to maintain a safe QC environment.

**Team Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build, guide, and supervise the QC team including chemists, analysts, and lab assistants.
* Allocate work, review performance, and ensure technical competence of team members.
* Train team members on test methods, equipment usage, documentation, and laboratory discipline.
* Foster a culture of accuracy, responsiveness, compliance, and ownership.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Improve laboratory efficiency, turnaround time, testing reliability, and reporting quality.
* Track quality trends and generate actionable insights for reduction in rejection, rework, and process variability.
* Recommend better testing practices, automation opportunities, and stronger analytical controls.
* Contribute to improvement of plant quality performance and customer confidence.

  
  

**Desired Profile:**

* M.Sc (Chemistry / Inorganic Chemistry) with 8 to 10 years experience in Quality Control preferably in the manufacturing of inorganic chemicals with Chemicals / Inorganic Chemicals / Speciality Chemicals / Process Manufacturing.
* Experience in setting up or stabilising QC systems / laboratories in a new or expanding plant will be strongly preferred.
* Exposure to handling hazardous chemicals and related testing/safety disciplines is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of laboratory systems, chemical testing, and quality control processes.
* Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, calibration, and consumable planning.
* Good understanding of specifications, sampling, test methods, COA preparation, and rejection/release protocols.
* Strong documentation and audit readiness mind-set.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with production and other plant departments.
* High level of discipline, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.

* Familiarity with ERP/LIMS/reporting systems will be an advantage.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Product Engineer, Gaming

**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

**About:**

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
**data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership**
, and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for
**high-IQ, product-minded engineers**
who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end-to-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.

**The Role:**

You’ll be the person who
**collapses the gap between idea and evidence**
.

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
**hypotheses → prototypes → production systems**
.

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

**What You'll Do:**

* **Ideation & Concept Testing**
  : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
* **Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership**
  : Own prototype lifecycle end-to-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
* **Feature Development & System Ownership**
  : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems**
  : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation & Data**
  : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking**
  : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

**What You'll Bring:**

***Must-Haves:***

* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
  **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

**Why You'll Love It Here:**

* **Impact:**
  You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:**
  You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:**
  You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:**
  You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:**
  We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.

**Implementation Lead**

**Location-Bangalore / Noida**

**Shift / Coverage-**6:30 PM-3:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; aligned to U.S. core hours 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST

Job Summary

The Disconnect Lead provides day-to-day operational leadership for customer disconnect activities, including Order Entry, circuit and design validation, inventory removal, Access Service Requests (ASRs), Local Service Requests (LSRs), circuit implementation and disconnect cost optimization. The role oversees automated and manual workflows, manages workload and priorities, ensures milestones and SLAs are achieved, maintains quality and data accuracy, and guides the team through complex issues and fallout.

The role works across Order Entry, Transport, IP, Planning, Order Management, Finance, Implementation Coordinators, Operations, carriers, off-net vendors and automation platforms to ensure disconnect orders are completed cleanly, accurately and within committed timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Lead day-to-day activities across the disconnect workstream, including Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR/LSR submission, inventory removal and circuit implementation.

Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders, critical due dates and shift coverage; balance urgent restorals, supplements/cancels and production commitments.

Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT, aging, fallout and delivery performance; take corrective action when performance or committed dates are at risk.

Review and guide disconnect design validation, including disconnect scope, ECCKT, circuit history, CFA/PON details, prior order activity and inventory records.

Ensure ASRs/LSRs comply with ASOG and vendor-specific ordering requirements, using automated workflows and manual fallback processes when required.

Oversee the end-to-end disconnect lifecycle across data, notifications, vendor maintenance, fallout, reports, escalations, documentation and closure.

Drive disconnect cost optimization by working with internal teams to eliminate avoidable or unhealthy vendor costs to Lumen.

Review and troubleshoot complex disconnect, provisioning and automation-workflow issues; determine when escalation or specialist support is required.

Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, Order Entry, Transport, IP, Operations, Finance, implementation teams, carriers and off-net vendors.

Recognize competing priorities and operational risks early, taking action or escalating before customer or business commitments are affected.

Ensure process adherence, accurate account notes, logs, communications, inventory updates and compliance with company, regulatory and customer requirements.

Coach team members, provide telecom/process/tool guidance, support knowledge transfer and identify skill or knowledge gaps.

Identify process gaps, recurring issues and data-integrity risks; drive standard work, quality assurance, process improvement and automation.

Provide clear operational updates to stakeholders and leadership, including status, risks, dependencies, decisions and recovery actions.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning, circuits, carrier provisioning, disconnect workflows and network operations.

Experience creating or managing ASRs/LSRs in a telecom or network-operations environment.

Working knowledge of Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASOG, vendor ordering requirements and/or network implementation.

Ability to interpret circuit designs, ECCKTs, CFA/PON data, order history and disconnect documentation.

Proven experience leading or coordinating an operational team, including workload, priorities, coaching and delivery controls.

Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging, operational KPI, quality and productivity management.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making; ability to pivot quickly and expedite resolution in a fast-paced environment.

Ability to manage multiple orders, critical deliverables and competing priorities without losing ownership or accuracy.

Strong stakeholder and vendor coordination, with clear written and verbal communication and confidence leading operational discussions.

Positive attitude, ownership, adaptability and willingness to learn and improve processes.

Good to Have

Experience supporting customer disconnects, service terminations or disconnect cost optimization.

Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.

Familiarity with FlightDeck automation and manual fallback processes; knowledge of Swift, SAM/Razor, PRIME, PRO/XLR or ASRI.

Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals, telecom OSS/BSS and Lumen provisioning/disconnect/inventory systems.

Advanced Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.

Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Performance Measures

**Performance Area**

**Measures**

**Delivery**

SLA/TAT attainment, milestone adherence, aging reduction and due-date performance.

**Quality**

Order, ASR/LSR, inventory and documentation accuracy; minimal fallout and rework.

**Operational Control**

Work allocation, backlog/WIP health, risk identification and timely corrective action.

**People Leadership**

Team readiness, coaching effectiveness, knowledge transfer and capability development.

**Continuous Improvement**

Process-gap closure, automation adoption and disconnect cost optimization.

Work Environment

Shift-based schedule as noted above; flexibility and extended hours may be required based on business and customer needs.

Frequent interaction with technicians, coordinators, managers, vendors and customer-service teams using Microsoft Teams and email.

Desk-based role requiring sustained concentration, accuracy and review of detailed information across multiple applications.

jobs.title: Consultant, Product - Tech, Insight
jobs.description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
This is a Consulting role for 3 - 6 months
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

jobs.title: Trading Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills:**
**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React
* Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms
* Experience consuming and querying OpenSearch for fast, flexible reporting and fuzzy filtering
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL-backed data solutions
* Experience coaching or mentoring engineers in a delivery-focused environment

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Overview**
The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high-impact products that meet business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute 5-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence
* Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P&L to optimize margins
* Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns
* Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases
* Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle
* Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality
* Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction
* Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management
* Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools
* Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning
* Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement
* Partner cross-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption
* Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs

**KPIs**

* Revenue and profitability by product line
* Market share growth vs. competitors
* ROI on new product development
* Roadmap execution (on-time, in-scope delivery)
* Customer satisfaction and product adoption

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
* Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals.
* Advanced proficiency with product lifecycle management tools, data analysis platforms, and performance tracking systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills rooted in data-driven decision-making and customer-centric product development.
* A relentless pursuit of excellence and a strong desire to build innovative products that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation.
* Deep commitment to ownership, continuous learning, and taking proactive steps to improve product outcomes.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, marketing, or a related field.
* Advanced knowledge of product positioning, pricing strategies, and P&L management.
* Experience in developing business cases, ROI analysis, and product roadmaps.
* Deep understanding of Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, translating into product requirements.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
