jobs.title: Growth Product Manager B2B Cloud Marketplace & Data Platform Germn MNC
jobs.description:
**Job description**

  
  

**Purpose of the role**

  

Company Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Org.

MPS\_OS is the cloud and data platform of Company MPS. Its products, including cloud cost and AI spend management, observability and data streaming, are offered to engineering and finance teams that buy through the cloud marketplaces they already use. The aim is a self-serve motion: a customer finds the product on a marketplace, tries it free up to a threshold, pays through their existing cloud commitment, and expands as usage grows.

The Product-led Growth Manager builds and runs this motion. The role owns the path from listing and sign-up to activation, conversion and expansion, so that growth comes from the product itself and from a funnel that works without adding sales headcount at the same pace.

**Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Self-serve funnel ownership** - Own the end-to-end funnel: discovery, sign-up, install, activation, conversion and expansion. Define the activation event and the metrics for every step, and report them regularly.

**Marketplace listings and billing** - Own listings and commercial setup on the major cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud): public and private offers, metering, billing and drawdown against customer commitments. Work with Finance on invoicing and revenue recognition.

**Pricing and packaging** - Design free tiers, usage thresholds and paid plans. Keep the free product clearly separate from the enterprise offering so that free usage builds demand and does not erode paid value.

**Onboarding and time to value** - Design the first-run experience, documentation, sample data and guided set-up that take a new user to a first valuable result quickly, together with engineering and design.

**Lifecycle and expansion** - Build upgrade triggers, in-product prompts, lifecycle communication and account-expansion plays. Identify where usage signals a team is ready for more modules or for an enterprise conversation.

**Analytics and experimentation** - Instrument the product, build funnel and cohort dashboards, and run structured experiments on pages, onboarding, pricing and messaging. Make decisions from evidence and share what was learned.

**Go-to-market alignment** - Work with global marketing and sales on demand generation, partner channels and incentives that reward self-serve conversion. Agree clearly when an account moves from self-serve to a sales-assisted motion.

**Product feedback loop** - Bring usage data and user feedback into the roadmap. Prioritize the product changes that move activation, conversion and retention.

**Community and developer experience** - Own the quality of documentation, tutorials and the community presence that technical buyers use to evaluate a product.

**Entry strategy and expansion across products** - Choose the entry products and customer segments, for example AI spend and cloud cost management, and sequence the next Platform products into the same self-serve model.

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Number of self-serve sign-ups and activation rate
* Time to first value
* Free-to-paid conversion
* Share of revenue that is self-serve and billed through cloud marketplaces
* Expansion and net revenue retention of self-serve accounts
* Software attach on cloud accounts served by MPS
* Cost to acquire and payback on the self-serve funnel
* Speed and quality of experiments run

**Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, growth or product marketing, with at least 4 years owning a self-serve or product-led growth motion in B2B software, developer tools or cloud infrastructure.
* Has launched a product on a cloud marketplace (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) or run a free-to-paid funnel with measurable results.
* Experience in a thin, early funnel, with little data and a product that is being separated from an enterprise offering, is a strong advantage.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Product-led growth fundamentals: activation, time to value, conversion, expansion, free tiers and usage-based pricing.
* Cloud marketplace mechanics: listings, private offers, metering, commit drawdown and co-sell programmes.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management (FinOps), observability or data platforms, and with the technical buyer who evaluates them.
* Product analytics and experimentation: funnel and cohort analysis, A/B testing, SQL or equivalent, and tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar.
* Lifecycle marketing and in-product messaging, and the basics of SEO and developer content.

**Commercial skills**

* Pricing and packaging, unit economics and payback thinking.
* Ability to align sales, marketing and partners around a motion that changes how people are rewarded.

**Personal attributes**

* Curious, analytical and hands-on; comfortable building the first version of a funnel and improving it weekly.
* Strong written communication, and clarity in explaining a metric or a decision to senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative influencer who works across engineering, design, marketing, finance and sales without formal authority.
* Ownership of outcomes, and comfort with setting up the metrics that hold the role itself to account.

**Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for Platform engineering and security teams
* Global marketing and global go-to-market leadership
* Finance (pricing, billing, revenue recognition) and Legal
* Cloud marketplace and alliance managers at the hyperscalers
* Channel and technology partners
* Product owners of other MPS stacks that share the platform

**How to read this role**

This is a growth and product role with business accountability. It is not a sales role and not a pure marketing role. The ideal candidate has built a self-serve motion from a weak starting point and knows how cloud marketplaces turn usage into revenue.

jobs.title: Product Manager Smart Cities Tolling Traffic Management  Germn MNC
jobs.description:
**Job description**

  
  

**Purpose of the role**

  

Company Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Company.

. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll system play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

**Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll platform using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

**Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

**Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Vitalpro Consumer Pvt Ltd is an emerging leader in India’s hospitality and food and beverage sector, known for its innovative and quality-driven approach. The company builds beloved brands such as Saffron & Mishri, which reimagines traditional Indian mithai, and 224 Craftery, which blends global chocolate-making craft with flavors tailored to Indian tastes. Vitalpro focuses on creating memorable culinary experiences that balance tradition with modernity, backed by data-driven insights, precision marketing, and hyper-personalized engagement. With a strong emphasis on creativity, excellence, and people development, the company aims to transform India’s food culture while offering team members a growth-oriented, purpose-led career journey.

**Experience:**
6–12 Years

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Reporting To:**
Founder / Business Head

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and experienced New Product Development Lead to drive food innovation across our brands.

The role will be responsible for conceptualising, developing and commercialising differentiated food products across traditional Indian sweets, contemporary confectionery, chocolates, snacking and other food categories.

The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of food science, ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and consumer trends, combined with the creativity to develop exciting products and the execution capability to scale them commercially.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Innovation & Concept Development

* Drive the end-to-end new product development pipeline across food categories.
* Identify emerging consumer trends, consumption occasions and product opportunities.
* Develop innovative concepts across mithai, confectionery, chocolates, snacks and other food categories.
* Experiment with new ingredients, flavours, textures, formats and processing techniques.
* Develop differentiated products combining Indian food heritage with contemporary tastes and formats.
* Create product concepts aligned with brand positioning and consumer expectations.

2. Formulation & Product Development

* Lead product formulation, ingredient selection and recipe development.
* Conduct kitchen and laboratory trials to optimise taste, texture, appearance and overall product experience.
* Work on sugar reduction, ingredient optimisation, nutritional profiles and shelf-life enhancement.
* Explore new ingredients, functional ingredients and food technologies.
* Develop alternatives to existing formulations wherever required.
* Ensure products meet applicable FSSAI and food safety requirements.

3. Process Development & Commercialisation

* Translate prototype formulations into scalable commercial products.
* Develop manufacturing processes, process parameters and standard operating procedures.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to establish production feasibility.
* Identify suitable equipment, technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Drive pilot batches, production trials and product validation.
* Ensure consistency and repeatability across production batches.

4. Quality, Shelf Life & Packaging

* Develop products with appropriate shelf life and stability.
* Work on preservation technologies, packaging compatibility and storage conditions.
* Conduct sensory evaluations, stability studies and shelf-life trials.
* Establish product specifications, quality benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with packaging teams to identify suitable packaging solutions.

5. Costing & Commercial Viability

* Develop product costing and optimise ingredient costs.
* Ensure formulations meet target gross margins without compromising product quality.
* Identify alternative ingredients and vendors.
* Evaluate scalability, manufacturing efficiency and commercial viability.
* Work towards improving product economics through formulation and process optimisation.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with marketing and brand teams to translate consumer insights into product propositions.
* Collaborate with procurement on ingredient sourcing and vendor development.
* Partner with manufacturing and quality teams for product commercialisation.
* Coordinate with packaging, sales and business teams to ensure successful launches.
* Build and maintain a structured product development calendar and innovation pipeline.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–12 years of experience in food product development, R&D or food innovation.
* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of food ingredients, formulations and processing technologies.
* Experience in developing and commercialising food products at scale.
* Knowledge of shelf-life enhancement, preservation systems and food packaging technologies.
* Understanding of food safety standards, FSSAI regulations and quality systems.
* Strong analytical, experimentation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance creativity, product quality, cost and commercial feasibility.
* Experience working in FMCG, food manufacturing, confectionery or packaged foods preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of successful new product launches.
* Speed and efficiency of product development.
* Product quality, consistency and consumer acceptance.
* Shelf-life and product stability performance.
* Achievement of target product costs and gross margins.
* Successful scale-up from laboratory trials to commercial production.
* Innovation pipeline and launch calendar delivery.

The Ideal Candidate

A food innovator who combines the mind of a food scientist with the creativity of a product developer and the execution mindset of an FMCG professional.

Someone who is passionate about food, constantly curious about ingredients and technologies, and capable of converting exciting ideas into differentiated, scalable and commercially successful products.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**
Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.
  
  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* Technical expertise: recognised analytical subject-matter expertise; sound scientific judgement; disciplined problem-solving.
* People leadership: develops people, gives clear feedback, manages performance and builds inclusive, accountable teams.
* Stakeholder management: communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.
* Delivery focus: plans effectively, manages risk and resources, and delivers to agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments.
* Continuous improvement: challenges inefficient practices and converts learning into sustainable laboratory improvements.
* Quality, safety and integrity: demonstrates uncompromising commitment to HSE, quality systems and data integrity.

**Additional Information**

* Paid Vacation of 30days, 12 Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, compassionate leaves

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

jobs.description:
This is a cGMP and FSSC 22000 certified contract manufacturer specializing in nutrition, protein, energy, granola, and clean-label food bars. Operating from our manufacturing facility at Himalayan Food Park in Kashipur with a daily production capacity of up to 5,00,000 bars, we partner with leading FMCG and nutrition brands to deliver products from concept to shelf.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on **Production Manager** to oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at our Kashipur plant. You will lead daily shop-floor production across our sheet-and-cut, cold extrusion, baking, enrobing, and packaging lines while ensuring strict adherence to FSSAI, cGMP, and FSSC 22000 food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Execution:** Plan, schedule, and execute daily and monthly production targets across multiple bar-manufacturing lines (30g–150g SKUs) to ensure on-time order fulfillment.
* **Process & Line Management:** Supervise specialized food processing operations including slab/sheet-and-cut, low-pressure cold extrusion, baking, chocolate/compound enrobing, and primary/secondary automated packaging.
* **Quality & Food Safety Compliance:** Enforce cGMP, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and FSSAI guidelines on the shop floor. Oversee critical control points including inline metal detection and check-weighing systems.
* **Yield Optimization & Waste Reduction:** Monitor raw material consumption, batch yields, and rework; implement lean manufacturing practices to minimize wastage and downtime.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, train, and manage shift supervisors, machine operators, and floor workers; oversee shift scheduling, attendance, and shop-floor discipline.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA/QC), R&D (for new product trials and tech transfers), Maintenance, and Supply Chain/Stores teams to resolve bottlenecks smoothly.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain accurate daily production logs, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics, batch manufacturing records (BMR), and audit documentation for client and regulatory inspections.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
**Service Manager Job Description**

**1. Service Management**

* Develop and implement service policies, procedures, and standards to ensure consistency and efficiency
* Lead and supervise service technicians and service coordinator.
* Allocate service calls, installations, and preventive maintenance jobs(CMC).
* Monitor daily service activities, productivity, and discipline.
* Conduct technical training, safety training, and performance reviews.
* Ensure technicians follow SOPs, safety norms, and documentation standards.

**2. ERP Management (End-to-End)**

* Collect data for raising ticket, Designation, Phone number, Email ID, Machine Model, Serial Number, Complaint Description, Photo/ Video.
* Raise quotation based on the approval/ payment conformation, allot service technician as per the availability, competency, location and criticality of service.
* Ensure **job cards are raised accurately** for all service calls from Customer, Project team, and Sales team. (installation, breakdown, PM, AMC/CMC).
* Review job card details including complaint description, parts used, labour, travel, and service status.
* Ensure service reports are attached with job card.

**3. Coordination & Service Scheduling**

* Work closely with the **Service Coordinator** to:
* Receive service requests and log complaints.
* Schedule technicians and site visits.
* Track job status and escalation.

**4. Spare Parts & Warranty Control**

* Approve spare parts usage as per warranty/AMC/chargeable conditions.
* Monitor spare consumption against job cards.
* Ensure defective parts are returned and handed over properly to concern department.
* Coordinate with stores for inventory reconciliation.

**5. Billing & Payment Coordination (PI to Payment)**

* Review & Approve the Performa invoice and ensure all commercial documentation was completed.
* Verify completed job cards for **billing eligibility** (Warranty, AMC/CMC, out-of-warranty calls).
* Ensure timely submission of approved Performa Invoice to accounts for invoicing.
* Coordinate with accounts and service coordinator to track invoices.
* Follow up with customers for payment realization and resolve service-related billing queries.
* Ensure closure of service tickets only after payment confirmation.

\*

**6. Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling**

* Act as escalation point for service-related customer issues.
* Ensure professional communication with hospitals.
* Review customer feedback and take corrective actions.

**7. Compliance, Quality & Documentation**

* Maintain service reports, installation certificates, and AMC logs.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections related to service operations.

**8. Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Require to share Weekly Service Call Report & Weekly Installation Report to MD.
* Analyse repeat complaints, response time, closure efficiency on Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report.
* Require to share Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report to MD after review.
* Identify recurring technical issues and provide feedback to R&D and production teams.
* Improve service efficiency, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

Language Preferences: English, Hindi & Tamil

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* total work: 10 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Quality
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Assistant Manager Quality Assurance (QA/QC)**
-----------------------------------------------

**Location:** Silvassa

**Department:** Quality Control (QC)

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E.

**Experience:** 710 Years

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Assistant Manager Quality Assurance to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities across manufacturing operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, process compliance, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality management and food safety standards, including ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and oversee all Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and applicable quality and food safety standards.
* Handle customer and supplier quality requirements, complaints, and quality-related concerns.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and 8D problem-solving activities.
* Implement and monitor FMEA, the 7 QC Tools, and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Plan and conduct internal audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and product traceability audits.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
* Monitor and ensure effective implementation of Control Plans, PRP, OPRP, CCP, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Ensure proper functional testing, inspection, and validation of products and processes.
* Maintain quality documentation, inspection reports, test records, SOPs, and audit-related documents.
* Monitor product quality at incoming, in-process, and final inspection stages.
* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, R&D, and other departments to resolve quality-related issues.
* Ensure proper utilization, calibration, and maintenance of laboratory testing equipment.
* Develop and implement quality improvement plans to reduce rejection, customer complaints, and process deviations.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000 standards.
* Hands-on experience in RCA, CAPA, 8D, and FMEA.
* Good understanding of the 7 QC Tools and statistical quality control.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma.
* Understanding of PRP, OPRP, CCP, Control Plans, and SPC.
* Experience in internal audits, customer audits, and supplier audits.
* Knowledge of laboratory testing equipment and functional testing procedures.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**
------------------------

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E. in a relevant technical discipline.

**Experience:** 710 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (Field Technical Support – CNG)
jobs.description:
**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.

* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.

* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.

* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

jobs.title: ASSISTANT MANAGER – QUALITY ASSURANCE (3PL VENDOR)
jobs.description:
**Job Location:** Noida  
**Salary:** Up to ₹10 LPA  
**Experience:** 6–8+ Years  
**Position:** Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Food / FMCG / Food Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance to oversee end-to-end quality assurance and food safety operations across third-party manufacturing facilities and 3PL vendors.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety compliance, vendor quality governance, process monitoring, and regulatory adherence. The role requires hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturers or co-packers, conducting quality audits, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and maintaining food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vendor Quality Management & Audits**

* Conduct periodic quality and food safety audits at third-party manufacturing and co-packer facilities.
* Ensure vendor compliance with FSSAI, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and GMP standards.
* Monitor vendor quality performance and ensure adherence to established quality standards.

**2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material, and finished goods inspection processes at vendor locations.
* Review and approve batch release documentation, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and laboratory reports before dispatch.
* Ensure temperature compliance during product receiving, storage, and dispatch.

**3. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for customer complaints, non-conformances, and audit observations.
* Manage product hold and release processes, scrap/rework activities, and mock recall exercises.
* Ensure timely closure of quality-related issues.

**4. Process & Hygiene Monitoring**

* Monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), pest control, and sanitation programs.
* Oversee Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) validation and process control checks.
* Ensure food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained at third-party facilities.

**5. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams, along with external vendor quality teams.
* Train vendor personnel on quality standards, food safety practices, and testing protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor quality performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, or Biotechnology.
* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the Food, FMCG, or Contract Manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturing units, vendors, or co-packers is essential.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Experience in quality audits, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and statistical quality tools.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good team management and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to third-party manufacturing facilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in food safety, vendor quality management, and third-party manufacturing operations, who can independently drive quality standards and ensure regulatory compliance across multiple vendor facilities.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for consideration.**

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate II
jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Overview:**
The Senior Research Associate independently develops renovation and innovation products from formulation and laboratory evaluation through application validation, factory trials, scale-up, and transfer to manufacturing. This hands-on role requires regular work in Kemin and external laboratories and the ability to plan and execute factory trials at Kemin’s manufacturing facility. The role serves as the product owner for assigned products from concept to launch.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Renovation and Innovation Projects**

* Lead assigned renovation and innovation projects, or defined R&D workstreams within larger projects, from technical brief through formulation, laboratory evaluation, application validation, factory trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, and technical launch readiness.
* Define the technical scope, hypotheses, Critical to Quality requirements, success criteria, milestones, risks, resources, and deliverables with the project sponsor and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain current project plans and communicate progress, technical decisions, dependencies, risks, delays, and recovery actions before milestones are missed.
* Remain accountable for assigned technical deliverables until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved, required documentation is completed, and outstanding technical issues are formally transferred to the accountable function Perform Hands-On Laboratory and Application Work.
* Spend significant working time conducting experiments and application trials in Kemin laboratories and, when required, at external laboratories, customer facilities, partner facilities, and manufacturing sites.
* Independently formulate prototypes and conduct efficacy, stability, analytical, application-performance, and product-packaging compatibility evaluations.
* Design and execute robust experiments using appropriate controls, replication, statistical methods, and predefined acceptance criteria.
* Maintain complete and traceable records of protocols, raw data, observations, deviations, results, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Ensure laboratory, pilot, and production experiments are documented in accordance with applicable procedures and PIP requirements. The PIP Manual requires these experiments to be recorded in laboratory notebooks and white paper Plan and Run Manufacturing Trials.
* Independently plan, coordinate, and lead on-site factory trials at Kemin’s Gummidipoondi manufacturing facility.
* Establish trial objectives, protocols, material requirements, process parameters, sampling plans, Critical to Quality measures, and acceptance criteria before each trial.
* Work on-site with Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other relevant functions during trial execution.
* Lead technical troubleshooting, collect and analyze trial data, document conclusions, and ensure agreed follow-up actions are completed.
* Recommend whether a product is ready for reformulation, further testing, repeat trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, or technical launch readiness.

**Manage R&D Deliverables within PIP**

* Serve as the R&D Project Manager for assigned projects, working collaboratively with the Product Manager and the wider Product Innovation Process team.
* Develop and maintain the research plan and ensure assigned R&D activities and documentation are completed according to the applicable PIP stage and agreed schedule.
* Provide complete and timely technical data, white papers, trial reports, risk assessments, Critical to Quality evidence, packaging recommendations, and manufacturing-transfer information for PIP reviews and gate decisions.
* Proactively identify technical gaps, coordinate actions with relevant functions, and resolve outstanding requirements before requesting progression to the next PIP stage.
* Maintain accurate PIP documentation in the designated company project-management system.
* Support scale-up, launch, and post-launch technical follow-up, including additional efficacy, stability, quality, application, or manufacturing work when required.

**Generate Reliable Data and Technical Recommendations**

* Collect, analyze, interpret, and document research and trial data independently, ensuring traceability from raw data to conclusion.
* Apply fit-for-purpose analytical and application methods and confirm that instruments, standards, controls, and methods are suitable for use.
* Review data generated by interns/trainees, identify gaps, and determine whether additional work is required.
* Convert findings into clear recommendations on formulation, efficacy, stability, application performance, packaging, manufacturing feasibility, technical risks, and next steps.
* Use appropriate statistical methods and approved digital and AI-enabled tools to identify trends and improve the speed and quality of technical analysis and decision support.
* Apply independent scientific judgment when reviewing AI-assisted outputs and verify the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of information before use.

**Evaluate and Recommend Packaging**

* Evaluate and recommend appropriate packaging formats, materials, pack sizes, and technical specifications based on product compatibility, stability, customer application, storage, transportation, regulatory requirements, cost, and manufacturing capability.
* Plan and execute packaging compatibility and stability studies, and coordinate packaging trials when required.
* Work collaboratively with the Product Manager, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to test and finalize packaging through the applicable PIP stage-gate process.
* Include approved packaging specifications, compatibility evidence, storage requirements, and handling instructions in the technical transfer package.

**Build Scientific, Product, and Digital Expertise**

* Review relevant scientific literature, patents, competitor technologies, market developments, and customer requirements.
* Translate scientific and industry knowledge into technical hypotheses and potential renovation or innovation opportunities.
* Use approved AI and digital tools to improve literature reviews, patent-search preparation, experimental planning, data analysis, technical writing, and knowledge management.
* Protect confidential, proprietary, customer, and personal information when using AI or other digital tools and comply with applicable company policies.
* Do not rely on AI-generated content as a substitute for scientific evidence, qualified technical judgment, required approvals, or documented experimental work.
* Serve as the technical subject-matter expert for assigned products and maintain accurate, current, and reusable product knowledge.
* Prepare and review technical reports, protocols, white papers, presentations, internal publications, product guidance, and training materials.

**Drive Cross-Functional Commercialization**

* Proactively build and maintain effective working relationships with the PIP team and key functions, including Operations, Manufacturing, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Technical Service, and global R&D.
* Work collaboratively throughout the PIP process to align technical development with customer needs, product cost, commercial potential, packaging requirements, regulatory requirements, manufacturing feasibility, and launch priorities.
* Provide the technical inputs required for product costing, commercial evaluation, customer value assessment, scale-up planning, and investment decisions.
* Proactively engage relevant functions to resolve issues, obtain decisions, complete actions, and advance projects through the applicable PIP stages.
* Provide technically accurate content, product demonstrations, and training for Innovation Days, customer engagements, product launches, and internal capability development.

To own and grow company's branded business outside India across all international regions. The Head – International Business (Brands) sets the international brand and market strategy, builds and leads the regional team, expands the distributor network, opens new countries, and is accountable for secondary sales, stock health, new product introductions and the overall international revenue, profitability and forecast.

This is a business-building role, not an export-coordination role. The incumbent must be comfortable working directly with distributor owners, KOLs and institutional buyers, and equally comfortable reviewing numbers and presenting performance to the Management.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Strategy and Business Planning**

* Define the international brand strategy, country prioritisation and market-entry roadmap aligned with the Company's overall business plan.
* Prepare annual and monthly regional and country business plans, budgets, forecasts and pipeline, and ensure their achievement.
* Take full P&L ownership of international brands business: revenue, pricing, margin, trade terms and receivables, in coordination with Finance.
* Evaluate new market opportunities across private market, hospitals, institutions and government tenders.

**B. Distributor Network and Market Development**

* Develop secondary sales and product movement through existing distributors and their sales teams.
* Drive repeat orders, stock liquidation and inventory health, working with distributors on monthly sales plans and execution.
* Identify, evaluate, appoint and, where required, exit distributors; negotiate distribution agreements and commercial terms.
* Open new countries and expand company's presence beyond existing markets.
* Activate and improve the productivity of distributor sales and marketing teams through training, joint field work and review mechanisms.

**C. Brand, Product and Portfolio**

* Own international brand positioning, brand plans and promotional, digital and scientific initiatives with distributor marketing teams.
* Drive new product and new pack introductions and ensure successful market launches; introduction and upselling of new formulations.
* Gather market requirements and competitor intelligence and feed these to R&D, Regulatory and Supply Chain for new formulations, pack sizes and product development.
* Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market trends and emerging clinical nutrition opportunities.

**D. KOL and Scientific Engagement**

* Build and oversee KOL networks across assigned countries.
* Plan and ensure execution of RTMs, CNEs, scientific meetings and other healthcare professional engagement programmes in coordination with Medical / Scientific Affairs.

**E. Tender and Institutional Business**

**F. Regulatory, Supply and Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Production, Quality and Finance for forecasts, order fulfilment, shelf-life management, documentation and collections.

**G. Team Leadership and Governance**

* Hire, develop, coach and set KPIs for Regional Managers / BDMs; conduct regular performance reviews.
* Create a structured review rhythm: monthly secondary sales, stock and forecast reviews, quarterly business reviews and market visits.
* Present international business performance, risks and opportunities to the Managing Director and Management.
* Build a pipeline of internal talent and a succession plan for the international team.

**Essential Experience**

* 15+ years of international business, export or brand-management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple countries and a team.
* Background in Pharmaceuticals, Clinical Nutrition, Medical Nutrition, Nutraceuticals or Healthcare products.
* Proven record of working through international distributors and distributor sales teams, and of appointing distributors and opening new markets.
* Strong understanding of secondary sales, stock liquidation and repeat-order generation.
* Experience in private, institutional and tender business across emerging markets.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to the Indian Subcontinent, South-East Asia, Latin America & Caribbean, Middle East and Africa (West, East and Southern Africa) markets; exposure to CIS markets is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Compensation:** Consultant fee (fixed or monthly retainer or Project Based feedback ), to be discussed
* **Reporting to:** Project Head
* **Work mode:** On-site at the Chennai office for the project duration

Language:

* Hindi (Preferred)

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. InspireXT is on a mission to become the world's most trusted supply chain consulting partner, and to create a company where our clients, our people and our partners flourish.
