**WHY** **InspireXT****?**

Because transformation, at its best, is human. You’ll work with people who care deeply about what they do, who believe in trust before transactions, and who want to leave every client stronger than they found them. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. If that sounds like you – we’d love to hear from you. Apply to be part of our growth story.

Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.
* Data migration mapping and specification governance inpu

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ISO 22000 Auditor to join our team. * Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing findings, observations, and recommendations for improvements.

* Provide recommendations and support for corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay informed about industry trends and changes in regulations to ensure compliance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Recommend enhancements to audit processes and tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Engage in ongoing professional education to remain current with ISO standards and food safety practices.
* Attend relevant workshops, training sessions, and industry conferences.

* At least 2 years of work experience in food industry
* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.

OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.

**Job Description – Strategy and Policy Division, Quality Council of India (Hiring for Policy, Legal, Tech and Marketing roles)**

**About the Team**

Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the QCI is a team of young professionals working towards augmenting the capacity of government bodies in policy making and formulating high-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. Our work at SPD entails numerous domains, which includes creation of a national level product label scheme, a flagship initiative of the Government of India. The team functions as a high-impact delivery unit within QCI, combining policy research, regulatory analysis, and project execution in a fast-paced, government-facing environment.

**Role Summary**

Your role will support the end-to-end operationalisation of various policies & schemes that QCI designs & implements. The support largely involves regulatory research, creating systems, SOP drafting to stakeholder coordination with regulators and industry associations. Depending on the experience, you would be designated as an Analyst, Associate Manager, or Project Manager (see Section 6). This role blends regulatory and standards domain knowledge with policy research, and scheme-level project management.

**Why This Role Is a Unique Opportunity**

This is not a typical corporate or consulting role. You will be at the centre of building India’s branding framework from the ground up – a programme with direct implications for achieving the goals of Atmanirbhar and Viksit Bharat. The work you do here will shape real policy outcomes.

We are looking for individuals who want to point to a national programme and say, “I helped build that.” If you have domain knowledge in manufacturing, standards, or trade policy, combined with intellectual rigour and a commitment to public service, this is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**There are 4 different roles (listed from A to D below) for which we are hiring multiple candidates-**

**A. Strategy & Policy**

* **Research & Synthesis:**
  Research BIS, FSSAI and international standards, testing procedures, QCOs, DGFT import-export regulations, HSN codes, rules of origin, NTBs and SPS rules, and turn findings into concise briefs and policy notes for QCI, DPIIT and other stakeholders.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:**
  Analyse sector-level manufacturing and trade data (production, import penetration, localisation, HS-code trade flows) for sector selection, threshold-setting and impact assessment, and present it through dashboards, leadership and ministerial decks, and research, benchmarking and progress reports.
* **Drafting & Documentation:**
  Draft Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, FAQs, proposal notes, inter-ministerial correspondence and approval documents in government format.
* **Stakeholder & Project Coordination:**
  Coordinate with BIS, BEE, DGFT, Department of Commerce, CII, FICCI, ASSOCHAM and Sector Council members; prepare agendas, minutes and trackers; and track scheme milestones (portal, sector onboarding, Sector Councils) with ministries and QCI leadership.

**B. Legal**

* **Legal Vetting & Drafting:**
  Draft and vet Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, Sector Addenda, undertakings, certificate holder terms, portal terms and privacy notices, MoUs and vendor contracts; prepare legal notes, opinions and file notings; and flag legal risk before any document is issued.
* **Enforcement, Disputes & Litigation:**
  Draft show-cause notices, suspension and cancellation orders, and grievance and appeal decisions in line with natural justice and SOP timelines. Manage challenges from notice to outcome: keep the court and limitation calendar, brief counsel, review pleadings, attend hearings, advise on appeals, and coordinate with the nodal Department where the Union of India is a party.
* **Law Firm & Panel Management:**
  Empanel law firms and counsel; allocate matters, fix scope and fees in work orders and check invoices; and hold firms to QCI’s standards on availability, forum coverage (Supreme Court to district courts, tribunals and consumer fora), conflicts and reporting.
* **IP & Brand Protection:**
  Protect the scheme’s name, logo and QR mark in India and abroad: trademark and certification mark filings, licence terms, register watch, oppositions, online takedowns, cease and desist notices and infringement actions.
* **Regulatory & Trade Law Research:**
  Interpret the BIS Act and QCOs, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, Foreign Trade Policy, customs and rules of origin, WTO and FTA obligations, trademark and GI law, the Consumer Protection Act and CCPA guidelines, and the DPDP and RTI Acts, and brief leadership at QCI and DPIIT.
* **Coordination, Records & Reporting:**
  Coordinate with DPIIT, BIS, DGFT, CCPA, law officers and industry bodies; maintain the Matter Register and precedent bank and feed lessons into SOPs; safeguard manufacturer data (including BOM and cost data); handle RTI and grievance responses; and report on open matters, risk and legal spend.

**C. Technology (Scheme Portal)**

* **Requirements, Design & Product Ownership:**
  Translate the Scheme Guidelines and SOPs into requirements, process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria for each portal module; own the backlog and release roadmap; and review the vendor’s UI/UX, architecture, data models and integrations so the portal is simple for MSMEs, bilingual, mobile-responsive and accessible.
* **Vendor & Delivery Management:**
  Support the RFP and bid evaluation; govern the vendor against plan, milestones and SLAs; assess change requests for scope, effort and cost; and verify deliverables before milestone payments.
* **Testing, Security & Go-Live:**
  Run UAT, triage defects and sign off releases; oversee go-live, data migration and rollback; and ensure CERT-In empanelled audits, compliance with GIGW, the DPDP Act, 2023 and hosting norms, and sound backups, disaster recovery, access control and audit trails.
* **Operations, Support & Reporting:**
  Monitor uptime, helpdesk and incidents against SLAs; secure documentation and knowledge transfer to avoid vendor lock-in; coordinate manuals and training; and define MIS dashboards for QCI and DPIIT.

**D. Marketing & IEC**

* **Marketing Strategy, Research & Campaign Planning:**
  Support the development of marketing and IEC strategies, campaign plans, audience segmentation, communication objectives and key messages, informed by market, audience and communication research and stakeholder feedback.
* **Brand Communication & Content Development:**
  Develop and coordinate clear, consistent communication materials such as brochures, presentations, FAQs, reports, infographics, videos, digital creatives and campaign content.
* **Digital Marketing, Monitoring & Reporting:**
  Coordinate digital outreach, social media content calendars, channel dissemination and audience engagement; track outreach coverage, participation, digital reach and engagement; and use these insights to refine communication and prepare periodic reports and recommendations.
* **Outreach, Events & Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Support awareness campaigns, workshops, conferences, trade fairs and outreach activities; coordinate with internal teams, industry bodies, partners and other stakeholders.
* **Agency & Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate briefs, deliverables, timelines and quality reviews with marketing, creative, media, event and IEC agencies or vendors.

Genuine interest in India’s manufacturing, trade and standards ecosystem and its policy developments.

jobs.title: Senior Purchase Manager
jobs.description:
This role is to manage end-to-end procurement operations from pre-order planning to post-order follow-up ensuring cost-effective, timely, and compliant purchasing aligned with project needs. The role drives vendor coordination, inventory checks, cost analysis, and process improvements to support smooth project execution and organizational efficiency.

  

**1. Pre-Ordering**

a) Study Master Indent received from the planning department for technical specifications, approved makes, lead time, and pricing versus make. Highlight any discrepancies.

b) Involve the Project Manager to divide the Master Indent into planned dispatches.

c) Categorize indents into capital goods, tailor-made goods, ready-to-dispatch goods, and rate contract goods.

d) Allocate Purchase Assistants for specific projects.

e) Cross-verify the Master Indent with the stock register for available inventories and highlight them.

  

**2. Ordering**

a) Prepare guidelines for the procurement process and ensure timely execution.

b) Supervise staff for productive output.

c) Verify the Own Cost (OC) sheet received from the HOD and hand it over to Purchase Assistants.

d) Prepare cost estimates and manage the budget.

e) Send inquiries of capital items to vendors with proper specifications on time.

f) Review and evaluate the Cost Comparison Sheet prepared by subordinates after initial negotiation.

g) Negotiate with vendors for price, delivery, and payment terms. Update the cost comparison sheet accordingly.

h) Obtain approval from HOD on the cost comparison sheet and release purchase orders.

i) Follow up on GA drawings with vendors and ensure timely release of purchase orders.

j) Manage vendor payments and cash flow requirements.

k) Ensure timely delivery of procured items and arrange Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for capital items.

  
  

**3. Post-Ordering**

a) Oversee inward and outward registers regularly.

b) Follow up with vendors for any shortages or rejected materials.

c) Arrange test certificates for supplied goods and maintain supplier databases and purchase records.

d) Certify purchase bills with proper documentation and coordinate material dispatch with the project manager.

e) Coordinate replacement or repairs for goods under warranty.

  

**4. Value Addition**

a) Develop and evaluate new vendors, prepare rate contracts, and maintain revisions.

b) Conduct ledger reconciliation for vendors regularly and ensure GST-R1 uploads.

c) Prepare suppliers' payment lists for approval.

d) Work closely with all departments and factories.

e) Review the delegation of work to the team, provide daily reporting to HOD, prepare MIS reports, and send them to higher management regularly.

f) Improve purchasing systems and processes and build and maintain good relations with suppliers.

g) Ensure compliance with laws, rules, and regulations.

  

**Educational Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Mechanical, Electrical or related field

  

**Experience:**

Minimum 15-18 years of experience in procurement and purchasing operations.

Experience in HVAC, cleanroom, MEP, pharmaceutical, or industrial projects preferred.

Strong experience in vendor management, procurement planning, and commercial negotiations.

Knowledge of ERP systems, inventory management, and procurement documentation.

Experience in handling project-based procurement activities.

Proven experience in procurement or purchasing roles, preferably in a managerial capacity.

Familiarity with sourcing strategies, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiation.

Experience in budget management and cost control.

Proficiency in MS Office and procurement software.

  

**Skills**:

Strong negotiation and vendor management & communication skills.

Knowledge of procurement lifecycle and supply chain processes.

Commercial awareness and cost control abilities.

Ability to manage multiple projects and procurement schedules.

Good analytical and decision-making capability.

Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Excel, Word, and procurement software.

Leadership and team management abilities.

Budget management and cost control.

Knowledge of procurement processes, regulations, and compliance.

Job Description: Quality Control (QC) Officer / Executive – Food Industry

**Job Title:** Quality Control (QC) Officer / Executive

**Department:** Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)

**Industry:** Food & Beverage Manufacturing / Processing

**Reports To:** Quality Manager / Plant Head

**Location:** KOLLAM

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

The **Quality Control (QC) Officer** is responsible for ensuring that all raw materials, in-process goods, and finished products meet statutory food safety standards, internal quality specifications, and hygiene guidelines. This role involves performing routine physical, chemical, and microbiological testing, monitoring hygiene and sanitation on the production line, maintaining regulatory documentation, and preventing standard deviations during processing.

Key Responsibilities1. Quality Inspection & Testing

* **Raw Material & Packaging Testing:** Inspect incoming raw materials, ingredients, and packaging materials to verify compliance with quality specifications before accepting deliveries.
* **In-Process Quality Monitoring:** Conduct routine checks on production lines (e.g., temperature control, weight checks, seal integrity, moisture levels, pH, viscosity, and sensory evaluation).
* **Finished Product Testing:** Sample and test finished goods prior to release, verifying compliance with regulatory guidelines and customer requirements.
* **Laboratory Operations:** Perform standard chemical analysis (acid value, moisture content, peroxide value, brix, etc.) and collect samples for internal/external microbiological testing.

2. Hygiene, Sanitation & Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)

* Audit production areas, equipment, and personnel for compliance with **GMP**, **GHP (Good Hygiene Practices)**, and company sanitation SOPs.
* Monitor sanitation cycles (CIP/COP processes) and swab testing of equipment and food-contact surfaces.
* Oversee pest control activities and coordinate with external pest control service providers.

3. Compliance & Standards Management

* Maintain and monitor food safety systems, including **HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point)**, **ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000**, and local regulatory codes (e.g., FSSAI, FDA, EFSA).
* Monitor **Critical Control Points (CCPs)** and **Operational Prerequisite Programs (OPRPs)** on the shop floor.
* Log all non-conformances, initiate corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans, and isolate non-conforming products.

4. Documentation & Record Keeping

* Maintain comprehensive records of daily test reports, certificate of analysis (COA), equipment calibration logs, and line inspection sheets.
* Assist in internal and third-party food safety audits.

Qualifications & SkillsEducational Background

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field.

Work Experience

* **1 to 4 years** of hands-on Quality Control / Quality Assurance experience within a food manufacturing, processing, or packaging plant.

Technical & Soft Skills

* Solid understanding of food safety standards (**HACCP, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, GMP**).
* Hands-on experience with laboratory testing equipment (pH meters, refractometers, titrators, analytical balances, etc.).
* Familiarity with local and international food regulations.
* High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
* Effective communication skills to coordinate with production, procurement, and warehouse teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Reduction in Line Non-Conformances & Product Defect Rates**
* **100% Adherence to CCP & Hygiene Audits**
* **Zero Regulatory Audit Deviations**
* **Timely Release of Finished Goods Batches**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About the job**

**Job Title:** Plant & Commercial Chartered Accountant - Completed (Preferred) and Pursuing

**Location:** Corporate Office: Bhandup, Mumbai 400078

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**CTC:** Competitive (Capped at 15,00,000/- per annum)

**Office Timings:**

* Monday to Friday: 09:30 Hrs to 18:30 Hrs
* 1st, 3rd, and 5th (if any) Saturdays: 09:30 Hrs to 13:30 Hrs

About the Organisations

* **AGT Foods India Pvt. Ltd.** is the Indian subsidiary of AGT Food and Ingredients Inc., an integrated agricultural processing and supply chain leader in pulses, grains, staple food commodities, and value-added food ingredients. Headquartered in Mumbai, AGT Foods India manages commodity procurement, import-export operations, trade financing, and high-volume distribution across regional and cross-border commercial trade corridors.
* **Umami Agro Industry Pvt. Ltd.** is the new production arm, establishing an integrated food processing facility at Khopoli, Raigad.

*(Corporate Websites: www.agtfoods.com*)

Role Summary

We are seeking an execution-oriented **Chartered Accountant (CA)** with 1–4 years of post-qualification experience in food processing, FMCG, or industrial discrete/process manufacturing.

This hybrid commercial and plant accounting role oversees end-to-end operational bookkeeping, inventory costing, multi-entity ledger reconciliations, and statutory compliance (GST/TDS) across both **AGT Foods India (corporate trading & commercial supply chains)** and **Umami Agro Industries (greenfield factory setup, pre-commissioning, and plant operations)**. The candidate will execute ground-level bookkeeping in **Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365** and Advanced Excel.

Role Clarification:

* **Current Operational Scope:**

      Hands-on transactional accounting and operational legwork across corporate and plant divisions.

      Daily execution of 3-way matching (PO vs. GRN vs. Invoice), vendor scrutiny, voucher entries, and physical inventory reconciliations.

      Setting up the Chart of Accounts, cost centres, project CAPEX ledgers, and trial balances for the new manufacturing facility.

**Not an Advisory Role:** Currently this is *not* a corporate statutory audit review, management consulting, investment banking, private equity valuation (DCF/NAV), or M&A desk profile. Future possibilities of including these responsibilities.

* **Future Strategic Evolution:**

      As the Khopoli plant transitions from setup to commercial scale, this role will evolve into commercial and financial leadership.

      Responsibilities will expand into plant-level MIS, OPEX/CAPEX variance management, supply chain working capital strategy, corporate direct/indirect tax planning, and liaison with statutory audit partners and lenders.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Core Bookkeeping, Multi-Entity AP/AR & Ledger Maintenance**

* Establish, align, and maintain the Chart of Accounts, cost centres, and voucher postings across AGT Foods India and Umami Agro Industries.
* Perform daily 3-way matching: verify Purchase Orders (PO), weighbridge / Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), and vendor tax invoices prior to booking.
* Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), process scheduled vendor payment runs, and resolve supplier ledger disputes.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliations (BRS), inter-company trade/fund balance reconciliations, and general ledger scrutiny.

**2. Factory Project CAPEX, Manufacturing Costing & Inventory Accounting**

* Track raw grain intake, packaging materials, Work-in-Progress (WIP), finished stock, scrap, and process shrinkage/yield variances.
* Audit and record project CAPEX cash outflows, civil contractor milestone billings, machinery import documents, customs clearance costs, and fixed asset capitalization schedules.
* Conduct monthly and quarterly physical stock counts at the Isambe, Raigad factory site and regional storage warehouses; reconcile physical inventory with ERP balances.

**3. Direct & Indirect Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare, reconcile, and file statutory returns: **GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9) and TDS/TCS (24Q, 26Q)**[cite: 6, 7].
* Ensure compliance with Reverse Charge Mechanisms (RCM), E-Way bill generation, and input tax credit (ITC) matching (GSTR-2B vs. books of accounts).
* Prepare audit workpapers and coordinate with statutory and tax auditors for financial year-end finalization under Schedule III of the Companies Act[cite: 6, 7].

**4. ERP Operations & Advanced Financial Modelling**

* Oversee day-to-day transaction entries, journal balancing, master data hygiene, and batch runs within **Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365**.
* Build dynamic, formula-driven financial models in **Advanced Excel** (XLOOKUP, Pivot tables, Index-Match, dynamic arrays) for plant cash-flow tracking, daily trade position reporting, and raw material procurement costing.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

* **Professional Qualification:** Qualified **Chartered Accountant (CA)** registered with ICAI, 1–4 years of post-qualification experience
* **Industry Background:** Mandatory operational accounting background in **Food Processing, Agro-Commodities, FMCG, or Process/Discrete Manufacturing**.
* **Greenfield / Setup Exposure:** Prior experience participating in the accounting setup, Chart of Accounts formation, or pre-commissioning bookkeeping of a new plant, factory project, or subsidiary is strongly preferred.
* **ERP Experience:** Operational working knowledge of **Microsoft Dynamics AX (DAX) or Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations)** is preferred; candidates with hands-on manufacturing experience in SAP (FICO) or similar enterprise ERPs will be considered.
* **Technical Skills:** High-level mastery of **Advanced MS Excel** for financial data cleanup and management reporting.
* **Work Location & Mobility:** Based primarily at the Bhandup, Mumbai corporate office, with flexibility for travel to the Umami Agro Industries factory site in Isambe, Raigad for physical inventory counts, asset audits, and operational accounting reviews.

**Job Title: Level 3 SOC Analyst**

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Reporting To: Sr. Director of Information Security

**Role Overview**

The Level 3 SOC Analyst serves as a technical authority within the Security Operations Center (SOC), responsible for advanced threat detection, incident response, and continuous improvement of security monitoring capabilities. This role handles the most complex security incidents, performs proactive threat hunting, develops detection logic, and mentors junior analysts while leveraging enterprise tooling such as CrowdStrike NG SIEM and CrowdStrike Endpoint Security (Falcon) to protect the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Advanced Incident Response & Analysis**

* Lead investigation and remediation of high-severity and complex security incidents, including advanced persistent threats (APTs), lateral movement, data exfiltration, and privilege escalation
* Perform deep-dive analysis using CrowdStrike Falcon Endpoint Security, including endpoint telemetry, process execution, memory artifacts, and identity-based activity
* Conduct enterprise-wide investigations leveraging CrowdStrike NG SIEM across endpoint, identity, cloud, network, and application log sources
* Coordinate containment, eradication, and recovery efforts using Falcon response capabilities (real-time response, host isolation, remediation actions)
* Produce detailed incident reports, root cause analyses, and executive-level summaries

**Threat Hunting & Detection Engineering**

* Proactively conduct threat hunting using Falcon telemetry and NG SIEM queries to identify attacker behavior not detected by automated controls
* Partner with Security Engineering to develop, tune, and maintain CrowdStrike NG SIEM detections, correlation rules, and alert logic
* Map detections and hunting hypotheses to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and tactics
* Continuously improve signal fidelity by reducing false positives and enhancing detection coverage
* Validate detection effectiveness through purple team exercises, adversary emulation, and tabletop scenarios

**Security Tooling & Automation**

* Serve as a subject-matter expert for:
* CrowdStrike Endpoint Security (Falcon Prevent, Detect, Respond)
* CrowdStrike NG SIEM
* automated response playbooks
* Design and enhance automated incident response workflows integrating Falcon containment and remediation actions
* Support onboarding of new log sources into CrowdStrike NG SIEM
* Identify visibility gaps and recommend improvements to logging, telemetry, and detection strategy

**Leadership & Mentorship**

* Act as the primary escalation point for the HGV SOC team.
* Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and quality assurance for investigations performed in CrowdStrike Falcon and CrowdStrike NG SIEM
* Develop and maintain SOC runbooks, SOPs, and investigation workflows specific to CrowdStrike tooling

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Partner with Security Engineering, NOC, and Engineering teams
* Translate CrowdStrike detection and investigation findings into actionable risk insights for stakeholders
* Support compliance, audit, and regulatory response efforts with evidence sourced from Falcon and NG SIEM

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Experience**

* 3+ years in a SOC or incident response role
* Proven experience leading complex security investigations in enterprise environments
* Hands-on experience operating EDR/XDR and SIEM platforms at scale

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of:
* Endpoint, identity, network, and cloud attack techniques
* Adversary tradecraft and malware behavior
* Windows, Linux, and macOS internals
* Demonstrated expertise with:
* CrowdStrike Endpoint Security (Falcon)
* CrowdStrike NG SIEM
* Netskope CASB
* Threat hunting and log analytics at scale
* Proficiency in scripting and query languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Falcon Query Language / SIEM queries)
* Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Incident Response lifecycle, and SOC best practices

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CrowdStrike certifications (e.g., CCFA, CCFR, CCSP) or equivalent experience
* SANS certifications (GCIA, GCED, GCIR, GCIH)
* CISSP, CISM, or similar senior-level certifications
* Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation
* Experience operating in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, government)

**Additional Skills**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement across global teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to translate technical risk issues into business impact for executive leadership.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence cross-functional teams

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Opportunity to lead and shape information security strategy in a dynamic organization.
* Learning & development support, including certifications and technical training.
* Collaborative, inclusive work culture in Hyderabads thriving tech ecosystem.

The role requires strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills along with hands-on experience in **QA planning, test management, defect tracking, UAT coordination, release readiness, and quality governance**. The candidate will work closely with project managers, developers, business teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure projects meet defined quality standards and delivery timelines.

**Project Coordination & Governance**

* Follow up with responsible stakeholders to ensure timely closure of actions and dependencies.
* Support project governance meetings and ensure decisions and action items are documented and tracked.
* Ensure project activities follow agreed processes, timelines, and quality standards.

**QA Leadership & Test Management**

* Own and coordinate the end-to-end QA lifecycle, including test planning, execution tracking, defect management, UAT, regression testing,and test closure.
* Prepare and maintain Test Plans, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, Requirement Traceability Matrices (RTM), Defect Reports, and Test Summary Reports.
* Monitor QA metrics such as test execution %, pass/fail rate, defect severity, defect ageing, defect leakage, reopened defects, and UAT readiness.
* Ensure critical and high-severity defects are resolved or formally accepted before production releases.
* Ensure appropriate testing evidence and QA documentation are maintained.

**UAT & Release Coordination**

jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

**1. Sourcing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and execute the overall sourcing strategy aligned with the company's business objectives, merchandise plans, and growth strategy.
* Create seasonal sourcing plans based on category requirements, fashion trends, demand forecasts, and business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to optimize sourcing through supplier diversification, near-shoring, and strategic partnerships.
* Develop long-term sourcing roadmaps to ensure scalability and business continuity.
* Evaluate global and domestic sourcing opportunities to improve competitiveness.

**2. Vendor Identification & Development**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop a robust network of domestic and international apparel manufacturers.
* Conduct supplier capability assessments covering production capacity, technical expertise, quality systems, compliance standards, and financial stability.
* Build long-term strategic relationships with key manufacturing partners.
* Develop alternate vendor sources to mitigate supply risks.
* Conduct regular supplier business reviews and implement supplier development initiatives.

**3. Product Development**

* Work closely with Design, Buying, and Merchandising teams during seasonal product development.
* Coordinate product sampling from concept to final approval.
* Ensure timely development of prototypes, fit samples, pre-production samples, and production approvals.
* Evaluate fabrics, trims, embellishments, washes, prints, and finishes to ensure alignment with brand standards.
* Drive innovation by identifying new materials, sustainable fabrics, and manufacturing techniques.

**4. Costing & Commercial Negotiation**

* Lead commercial negotiations on product pricing, payment terms, production capacities, lead times, and contractual agreements.
* Analyze garment costing to ensure competitive pricing while maintaining desired margins.
* Drive annual cost optimization initiatives through strategic negotiations and process improvements.
* Monitor raw material price trends and recommend sourcing strategies accordingly.
* Optimize total sourcing costs without compromising product quality.

**5. Vendor Performance Management**

* Define supplier performance scorecards covering:
* Quality
* Delivery adherence
* Cost competitiveness
* Responsiveness
* Compliance
* Capacity utilization
* Conduct quarterly vendor performance reviews.
* Drive continuous improvement plans for underperforming suppliers.
* Recommend vendor retention, expansion, or exit decisions based on performance.

**6. Production & Delivery Management**

* Ensure production schedules are aligned with merchandise launch calendars.
* Monitor production progress and proactively address capacity or timeline constraints.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure on-time shipment of finished goods.
* Minimize production delays through effective planning and supplier communication.
* Monitor critical path activities throughout the sourcing cycle.

**7. Quality Assurance**

* Work closely with Quality Assurance teams to establish quality standards for all product categories.
* Ensure adherence to approved specifications and quality benchmarks.
* Monitor first-pass quality, rejection rates, and corrective action implementation.
* Drive root cause analysis for recurring quality issues.
* Ensure customer complaints related to product quality are minimized.

**8. Compliance & Ethical Sourcing**

* Ensure all vendors comply with company policies and international sourcing standards.
* Monitor adherence to:
* Social Compliance
* Ethical Labour Practices
* Factory Safety Standards
* Environmental Regulations
* Sustainability Requirements
* Coordinate factory audits and compliance assessments.
* Ensure suppliers maintain necessary certifications.

**9. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Collaborate with Planning, Merchandising, and Supply Chain teams to maintain optimum inventory availability.
* Balance production planning to avoid stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Improve inventory turnover through efficient sourcing planning.
* Support replenishment strategies for core product categories.
* Coordinate allocation priorities during peak seasons.

**10. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with:
* Design
* Buying
* Merchandising
* Planning
* Quality
* Logistics
* Finance
* Retail Operations
* Participate in seasonal range planning meetings.
* Ensure seamless communication across all departments involved in product development and sourcing.

**11. Process Improvement & Digitalization**

* Standardize sourcing processes across product categories.
* Drive automation and digitalization of sourcing workflows using ERP/PLM systems.
* Implement sourcing dashboards for real-time tracking of supplier performance and production status.
* Improve sourcing efficiency through data-driven decision-making.

**12. Budget & Financial Management**

* Prepare and manage the annual sourcing budget.
* Monitor sourcing expenditures against approved budgets.
* Drive initiatives to improve gross margins through strategic sourcing.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings across the supply chain.
* Support annual business planning with sourcing cost forecasts.

**13. Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the sourcing, product development, and vendor management teams.
* Establish clear KPIs and performance expectations.
* Build succession plans for key sourcing roles.
* Foster a high-performance and collaborative team culture.
* Conduct regular coaching and capability-building sessions.

**14. Market Intelligence & Innovation**

* Monitor global fashion trends, sourcing markets, raw material developments, and emerging technologies.
* Benchmark sourcing practices against leading fashion brands.
* Identify opportunities to introduce innovative fabrics, trims, and sustainable solutions.
* Evaluate new manufacturing technologies to improve speed, quality, and cost efficiency.

**15. Risk Management**

* Identify sourcing risks related to supplier dependency, geopolitical changes, raw material shortages, and logistics disruptions.
* Develop contingency sourcing plans and alternate supplier strategies.
* Ensure business continuity through diversified sourcing networks.
* Monitor supplier financial health and operational risks.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with strong knowledge of machine design, Special Purpose Machines (SPM), New Product Development (NPD), 3D modelling, 2D drafting, engineering calculations and GD&T.

The candidate will be responsible for developing mechanical designs from concept to manufacturing, preparing detailed engineering drawings and coordinating with production, procurement and project teams.

Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Machine Design & SPM**

* Design and develop Special Purpose Machines (SPM) and industrial machinery.
* Develop machine concepts, mechanisms and complete mechanical assemblies.
* Prepare 3D models, assembly layouts and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Select motors, gearboxes, bearings, couplings, shafts and other mechanical components.

**2. New Product Development (NPD)**

* Handle end-to-end product development from concept to final manufacturing.
* Develop innovative mechanical solutions based on customer requirements.
* Conduct design feasibility studies, design reviews and product validation.
* Implement design modifications and product improvements.

**3. Engineering Design Calculations**

* Perform design calculations for shafts, gears, bearings, keys, fasteners and structural components.
* Calculate torque, power, RPM, forces, stresses and factor of safety.
* Perform material selection and component sizing.
* Understand hydraulic and pneumatic system design.

**4. 3D Modelling & 2D Drafting**

* Create 3D parts, assemblies and layouts using SolidWorks.
* Prepare detailed 2D manufacturing, fabrication and assembly drawings.
* Generate BOMs, GA drawings and technical specifications.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of engineering drawings.

**5. GD&T & Drawing Standards**

* Apply GD&T as per ASME Y14.5 / applicable engineering standards.
* Define dimensional and geometric tolerances.
* Specify datums, fits, clearances and surface finish requirements.
* Review drawings for manufacturing feasibility and inspection requirements.

**6. Manufacturing & Production Coordination**

* Coordinate with fabrication, machining, assembly and production teams.
* Resolve design and manufacturing-related technical issues.
* Review vendor drawings and component specifications.
* Provide engineering support during machine assembly, testing and commissioning.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in SolidWorks.
* Good knowledge of AutoCAD 2D drafting.
* Practical experience in industrial machine design and SPM.
* Knowledge of GD&T and engineering drawing standards.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design calculations.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, machining and fabrication.
* Experience in BOM preparation and engineering documentation.

Qualification & Experience

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 38 Years.
* **Software:** SolidWorks and AutoCAD.
* **Preferred Industry:** Industrial Machinery, Special Purpose Machines, Heavy Equipment, Mining Equipment, Recycling Machinery and Manufacturing Equipment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong problem-solving and technical skills.
* Ability to independently handle mechanical design projects.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work from concept development to manufacturing.
* Responsible for timely completion of design and drawing deliverables.

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

**Salary Range:** €45K - €55K

**Job Title: Principal Investigator – Process Engineer**
**Position Summary**
The Process Development group at Innovation Center in Hyderabad works as part of an interdisciplinary team to design and develop synthetic routes for commercial manufacturing processes. Principal Investigator – Process Engineer will provide engineering support of all phases of process development, with responsibility from early stage to commercial launch.  This role includes conducting laboratory-based programs to develop commercial manufacturing processes as part of a cross-functional team of process chemists, analytical chemists and engineers, also partnering with third party Contract Research Organizations (CRO) to ensure pilot campaign success and extract engineering learnings to be used in future commercial manufacturing designs.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**The Role (daily Responsibilities)**

* Lead chemical engineering deliverables for assigned synthetic programs from early and/or late-stage development through process characterization, technology transfer, piloting, validation, and commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and oversee process engineering deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), process descriptions, and detailed mass and heat balance calculations.
* Participate in rigorous risk assessments, HAZOP studies, failure-mode evaluations, and ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards.
* Provides subject matter expertise across development and scale-up, supporting technical package preparation, process and equipment fit assessment, scale-up strategies, facility readiness evaluations, technology transfer execution, validation activities, and post-transfer process stabilization.
* Provide strong technical leadership at CDMOs and manufacturing sites, including hands-on floor support, rapid troubleshooting, risk-based decision-making, issue escalation, and execution support during engineering, demonstration, pilot, and commercial campaigns.
* Build and maintain high-trust, high-accountability partnerships with external manufacturing partners by establishing clear governance, decision-making frameworks, communication pathways, performance expectations, and risk management processes.
* Lead or guide investigations, root-cause assessments, deviations, non-conformances, CAPAs, change controls, and process performance reviews using data-driven and science-based recommendations.
* Apply chemical engineering fundamentals, modeling, and manufacturing data to improve process capability, yield, purity, cycle time, safety, sustainability, productivity, and cost of goods.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and process simulation software (e.g., Aspen, MATLAB, Minitab, AutoCAD).
* Apply reaction engineering, thermodynamics, kinetics, heat and mass transfer, mixing, hydrodynamics, separations, filtration, drying, solid-liquid handling, and equipment design to development and manufacturing challenges.
* Create fit-for-purpose laboratory and engineering experiments, representative scale-down models, and process characterization studies that define mechanisms, operating ranges, robustness, and scale-up criteria.
* Integrate process safety, equipment and facility fit, material compatibility, containment, operability, maintainability, and human-factor considerations into process and technology-transfer decisions.
* Author, review, and defend engineering reports, technology-transfer packages, risk assessments, control strategy documents, technical investigations, and regulatory filing sections.
* Establish trusted relationships with CDMO leaders and technical teams while maintaining clear accountability, protecting FMC requirements, and addressing conflict or performance gaps directly and professionally.
* Distill complex technical information into concise recommendations, decision points, risks, and trade-offs for senior leaders, governance forums, regulatory stakeholders, and external partners.

**The Candidate (requirements)**

* Bachelor's or master's degree or Ph.D in Chemical Engineering is required.
* Chemical engineers with a strong foundation in chemical engineering and organic chemistry, combined with hands-on experience in process development, pilot plant operations, and commercial-scale manufacturing.
* 7-15 years in R&D process development in agrochemicals, pharmaceutical, fine or specialty chemicals industry required.
* Familiarity with concepts of developing safe and cost-effective chemical processes.
* Strong organic chemistry knowledge is a plus.
* Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively and work in teams of scientists.
* The ability to effectively develop and test hypotheses and quickly determine the feasibility of a proposal is critical.
* Willingness to work flexibly across multiple time zones and travel as required, including primarily domestic travel and occasional international travel.
* Flexible work schedules to accommodate work performed in different geographies required.
* Experience working in kilo, pilot and/or manufacturing scale environments is desirable.

jobs.title: Research Engineer (Process)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

jobs.title: Senior Process Chemist - Panoli, Gujarat
jobs.description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Job Description Of The Role**

* Develop and improve chemical processes for making existing and new products.
* Scale up processes from lab level to pilot and full production.
* Coordinate with teams like production, quality control, safety, and regulatory.
* Follow standard EHS practices (Environment, health & Safety).
* Proper understanding of process safety studies e.g., RC, DSC, ARC, ARSST, TSU and powder safety studies.
* Transfer lab-developed processes to manufacturing plants and help solve any issues.
* Develop plans for experimentation, DOE studies, negative studies. Draft clear reports, batch records, eLN and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Use and maintain lab equipment like reactors, chillers, and chemical processing equipment.
* Explore and perform novel chemical reactions, chiral chemistry, multi-step synthesis like halogenation and pressure reactions.
* Analytical data monitoring for the reaction using tools like NMR, IR, LC-MS, HPLC, GC, and GC-MS, PSD, XRD etc. Identify and study impurities- purification, crystallization, and distillation methods.
* Understand and control key process parameters to ensure consistent quality.
* Solving production issues and improving efficiency at different FMC global & domestic sites.
* Onsite support at sites for troubleshooting production issues and ensuring consistency.
* Selected person may have to work QC or other roles based on the organization requirement.

**Qualification**
**Essential: Master’s degree in organic chemistry from reputed college.**

* Desirable: PhD. In Organic Chemistry
* Experience: More than 5 years of experience in process development/ improvement, R&D and chemical manufacturing.

**Skill Set**

* Strong knowledge of organic synthesis and chemical engineering principles.
* Experience in scale-up and pilot plant operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of structural elucidation and interpretation by using analytical techniques such as NMR, IR, LC-MS, HPLC, GC and GC-MS, UV Visible spectrophotometer, KF titrator, conductivity meter.
* Knowledge about TLC, Rota vapor, EYELA small-scale synthesizer, EYELA small scale pressure reactor, automated lab reactors of 1L to 20L with different agitators, SPDU, WFE, Huber thermostats, Julabo chilling systems.
* Good documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
* Multistep organic synthesis and custom Synthesis of molecules from gram to kilogram scale. [Chlorination, Bromination and Pressure reaction]
* Synthetic route optimization/process stabilization, validation, and determination of critical process parameters.
* Identification of impurities, their characterization and crystallization techniques.
* Capable of technology transfer related to process from R&D to plant level and trouble shooting.
* Agriculture / Specialty fine chemical / Pharma experience strongly preferred.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.
  
  
**How will you fit in the big picture?**
The Senior Microbiologist is responsible for microbiological quality assurance and food safety activities across six manufacturing lines and ten SKUs. The role supports product safety and release by leading microbiological sampling and testing, environmental and hygiene monitoring, laboratory and shift activities, audit readiness, documentation, corrective actions, GMP implementation, and microbiology performance reporting.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Perform online sampling and microbiological analysis of ingredients, semi-finished products, and finished products.
  
  
Manage the Environmental Microbiological Monitoring Program (EMMP), personnel hygiene monitoring, and ATP monitoring.
  
  
Support validation of cleaning and sanitation programs and troubleshoot microbiological issues.
  
  
Manage microbiology shift activities and maintain microbiology laboratory management system documentation and records.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) meetings for microbiological issues, follow up actions, and report outcomes.
  
  
Handle and report proficiency testing activities and verify microbiology records.
  
  
Conduct weekly and monthly GMP and personnel hygiene audits and support audit readiness.
  
  
Train food handlers on GMP and encourage a Right First Time quality culture.
  
  
Perform trend analysis of plant microbiology issues and prepare monthly KPI and data reports.
  
  
Support SAP release of finished goods.

Experience:
  
  
Minimum 4-5 years of experience handling microbiological analysis of food products and/or beverages. Sound microbiology knowledge and ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues are required, along with team management, influencing, and communication skills.
  
  
Education:
  
  
M.Sc. in Microbiology.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

The Project Lead runs JOMARA's new product development (NPD) and commercial execution projects from first idea to delivery on shelf. You will own the plan for every new product, new and seasonal packaging, supermarket planograms and trade show participation. You will coordinate internal teams, suppliers and retail partners so every launch lands on time, on budget and to JOMARA's premium standard.

**Key Accountabilities:**

New Product Development (NPD)

* Lead NPD projects end-to-end: concept, product brief, development and sampling, costing, approvals, production trial and launch.
* Run a stage-gate process with clear milestones, owners and sign-offs at each step.
* Coordinate Production, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales and Finance throughout each project.
* Make sure every product meets labelling, shelf-life, certification (organic, halal, food safety) and market import requirements.
* Track performance after launch and feed lessons into the next project.
* Forecasting and planning along with the supply chain

**Packaging Development (new and seasonal)**

* Manage new packaging and redesign projects from brief to delivered stock: agency briefing, artwork, proofs, approvals, printing and supplier lead times.
* Plan and deliver seasonal and gifting packaging (Ramadan, Eid, Hajj & Umrah, National Day, year-end and international festive seasons) on a calendar that works back from in-store dates.
* Manage packaging suppliers, minimum order quantities, costs and quality checks.
* Check artwork accuracy for each market: languages, regulatory text and barcodes.

**Planogram and In-store Execution**

* Manage Jomara planograms for supermarket partners: prepare proposals, agree them with category managers and track implementation.
* Build new listings and range changes into planograms together with Sales and merchandising teams.
* Run store checks on planogram compliance, share of shelf, pricing and visibility; report gaps and corrective actions.
* Support seasonal displays and secondary placements in store.

**Trade Show**

* Own the trade show calendar and budget (e.g. Gulfood, SIAL, Anuga and other target-market shows)
* Manage the full trade show checklist: registration, stand design and build, samples and shipments, marketing materials, logistics, travel and visas, staffing, lead capture and post-show follow-up.
* Report leads and return on investment after each show.

**Project Delivery Management and Coordination**

* Keep one project tracker covering all projects: timelines, owners, budget, risks and status.
* Run regular project meetings and prepare status updates for the Director – JOMARA International.
* Flag risks and delays early, agree fixes and escalate when needed.
* Build standard templates and checklists (NPD stage-gate, packaging critical path, trade show checklist) so delivery is repeatable.

**Key Performance Indicator**

* NPD and packaging projects delivered on time, within budget and to specification.
* Seasonal packaging in stores by the agreed date for every season.
* Planogram compliance and share of shelf in key supermarket accounts.
* Trade show checklists completed on time; leads generated and converted.
* Sales from new products versus plan.
* Stakeholder feedback on coordination and follow-through.

**Experience requirement:**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain or a related field.
* 3–5 years' experience, with at least 2 years leading cross-functional projects or programmes.
* Background in FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods.
* Hands-on experience launching products, customers or markets (export or international expansion preferred).
* Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort with project management tools.
* Fluent English.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the GCC (UAE and KSA) retail and e-commerce.
* Exposure to food export compliance (labelling, certifications, import rules) worldwide.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Structured and organised:**
  turns big goals into clear, workable plans.
* **Commercially minded:**
  understands how projects drive sales, margin and brand growth.
* **Influence without authority:**
  gets results through people across functions and partners.
* **Clear communicator:**
  writes and presents simply, for both working teams and senior leaders.
* **Analytical:**
  comfortable with numbers, budgets and trade-offs.
* **Proactive and resilient:**
