As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.
  
  
A DAY IN THE LIFE …
  
  

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Head Chef will be responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, ensuring consistent food quality, maintaining high standards of food presentation, managing kitchen staff, controlling food costs, and ensuring compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations.

The role requires strong culinary expertise, leadership capabilities, creativity, and the ability to manage kitchen operations efficiently while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kitchen Operations & Food Production:**

* Oversee and manage all daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure timely preparation and delivery of food orders.
* Maintain consistency in food quality, taste, portion sizes, and presentation.
* Develop and implement standard recipes and food preparation procedures.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to company standards.
* Monitor kitchen workflow and ensure efficient coordination between kitchen sections.
* Introduce new dishes, seasonal menus, and innovative food concepts.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment and facilities.

**Menu Planning & Development:**

* Develop, review, and update food menus in coordination with management.
* Create new recipes and improve existing dishes.
* Conduct food trials and tastings before introducing new menu items.
* Ensure menu pricing is aligned with food costs and profitability targets.
* Monitor food trends and introduce innovative culinary ideas.
* Ensure menu items meet customer expectations and brand standards.

**Team Management & Leadership:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and develop kitchen employees.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities among kitchen staff.
* Prepare kitchen duty rosters and manage staff scheduling.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular training on cooking techniques, food safety, and hygiene.
* Maintain teamwork, discipline, and a positive working environment.
* Identify training needs and support employee development.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels across all kitchen sections.

**Food Cost & Inventory Management:**

* Monitor food costs and ensure achievement of budgeted targets.
* Control food wastage, spoilage, and unnecessary expenses.
* Monitor stock levels and coordinate purchasing requirements.
* Ensure proper receiving, storage, and rotation of food items.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and stocktaking.
* Establish appropriate portion control and standard recipes.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure quality and competitive pricing.
* Monitor kitchen expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

**Food Safety & Hygiene:**

* Ensure strict compliance with UAE food safety regulations and applicable municipal requirements.
* Maintain high standards of kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
* Ensure proper food handling, preparation, storage, and temperature control.
* Monitor expiry dates and implement FIFO (First In, First Out) procedures.
* Conduct regular kitchen hygiene and safety inspections.
* Ensure staff follow personal hygiene and grooming standards.
* Maintain food safety records and inspection documentation.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of hygiene or food safety violations.

**Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction:**

* Conduct regular food quality checks before dishes are served.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, temperature, and presentation.
* Handle food-related customer complaints professionally.
* Coordinate with restaurant service teams to ensure smooth food delivery.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement necessary improvements.
* Ensure all special dietary requirements and food allergies are handled appropriately.

**Equipment & Maintenance:**

* Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained in good working condition.
* Report equipment breakdowns and coordinate timely repairs.
* Ensure proper use and handling of kitchen tools and machinery.
* Monitor kitchen safety procedures and prevent workplace accidents.
* Maintain organized storage areas and kitchen workstations.

**Administration & Reporting:**

* Prepare daily and monthly kitchen operational reports.
* Monitor food cost percentages, wastage, and inventory consumption.
* Maintain recipe cards, food costing sheets, and kitchen records.
* Report operational challenges and staffing requirements to management.
* Assist management with budgeting and operational planning.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and standard operating procedures.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in professional kitchen operations.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a Head Chef or Sous Chef role.
* Strong experience in menu development, food costing, and kitchen management.
* Knowledge of international cuisines and modern cooking techniques.
* Good understanding of UAE food safety regulations.
* Experience in managing and developing multicultural kitchen teams.
* Previous UAE experience is a must.

The Executive Pastry Chef is responsible for leading the creation, development and execution of premium pastry and dessert concepts across Independent Food Company's portfolio, including the development and launch of new pastry brands.

The role combines brand creation, culinary innovation, product development and operational leadership, ensuring that each concept delivers a distinctive identity, exceptional product quality, commercial viability and a consistent guest experience.

The incumbent will lead the end-to-end culinary development of new pastry brands, from initial concept creation and menu development through kitchen design and layout planning, recipe standardization, equipment selection, team recruitment, training and successful operational launch.

While the role carries strategic and creative responsibilities, the Executive Pastry Chef must remain fully hands-on, actively participating in product development, tastings, production trials, training and new brand openings.

**Pastry Brand Creation & Concept Development**

1. Lead the culinary creation and development of new pastry, bakery and dessert brands, from initial concept ideation through commercial launch.

**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

* Highly disciplined, accountable, and responsible, with a strong sense of ownership.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and willing to learn and implement new technical knowledge.
* Strong commitment to laboratory safety, environmental protection, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatician

jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a large genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for leading the development, optimization, and automation of large-scale genomic data processing workflows, ensuring reliable, scalable, and reproducible analysis across diverse sequencing technologies. The position contributes to the advancement of production genomics capabilities through workflow innovation, cloud-based computing solutions, quality control frameworks, and continuous improvement of bioinformatics infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable bioinformatics pipelines and workflows for large-scale genomic data processing.
* Build and optimize automated workflows for sequencing quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, and downstream genomic analyses.
* Develop and manage workflow orchestration platforms such as Nextflow and equivalent workflow management systems.
* Improve workflow scalability, reproducibility, monitoring, performance, and reliability across high-volume sequencing datasets.
* Evaluate, benchmark, and integrate new bioinformatics tools, sequencing technologies, and analytical approaches into production environments.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and unexpected analytical results.
* Support harmonization of genomic data across sequencing platforms, software versions, pipelines, callers, and data releases.
* Apply best practices in genomic quality control, including assessment of sequencing metrics, sample integrity, contamination, variant quality, batch effects, and cohort release criteria.
* Contribute to cloud-based genomic computing environments, containerization technologies, workload optimization, and reproducible software deployment practices.
* Collaborate with scientists, bioinformaticians, software engineers, platform teams, cloud specialists, and data management teams to deliver technical and scientific objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of production genomics workflows and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, data governance requirements, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Document workflows, technical processes, and validation activities to support reproducibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Significant experience in production bioinformatics, genomic computing, workflow development, cloud genomics, or related technical fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale genomics infrastructure, pipeline development, or workflow automation projects.
* Experience working with whole genome sequencing (WGS) datasets and large-scale genomic analysis environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms, workflow orchestration frameworks, and high-performance computing environments is strongly preferred.
* Scientific publications, open-source contributions, or ownership of large-scale genomics systems are advantageous.
* Strong programming skills in Python, shell scripting, or related languages.
* Advanced Linux command-line proficiency.
* Experience with Nextflow or similar workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of genomic processing tools such as DRAGEN, Sentieon, GATK, bcftools, samtools, and related technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Singularity/Apptainer, containerized workflows, and reproducible software environments.
* Strong understanding of genomic file formats including FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, and gVCF.
* Expertise in genomic quality control, variant calling, structural variation analysis, and large-scale genomic data processing.
* Familiarity with Git, software version control, and workflow testing practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary technical and scientific teams.

jobs.title: F&B Licensing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

* A customer-focused approach and ability to build effective relationships across diverse cultures.

jobs.title: Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**
Location: Dubai (UAE) | Remote
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you ready to build your commercial career in a specialised market where animal biosecurity, food safety and hygiene make a real difference?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)**
to support the growth of LANXESS’ Material Protection Products business across the Middle East. You will focus on developing new business, strengthening customer and distributor relationships, and expanding our presence across animal biosecurity and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
The portfolio includes
**speciality biocides, disinfectants, hygiene solutions and preservation technologies**
used across animal production, poultry, dairy, livestock, food processing, beverage manufacturing and related industrial hygiene markets.
  
  
This is a commercially focused role for someone who enjoys being close to customers, spotting opportunities and developing business across different markets and cultures. You will work with customers, distributors, and internal technical, regulatory, and marketing colleagues while building your knowledge of the region and our applications.
  
  
The position is based in Dubai and covers the wider Middle East region.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop new business across the Middle East, identifying opportunities in animal biosecurity, poultry, livestock, dairy, food processing, beverage production and related markets.
* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, regional producers, multinational companies, distributors, consultants and other industry partners.
* Support and develop the regional distributor network, identifying opportunities to improve market coverage and penetration.
* Help develop country and customer growth plans and maintain a healthy pipeline of commercial opportunities.
* Act as a commercial contact for customers and distributors, helping them identify solutions for their application needs.
* Support existing customers through technical selling, product qualification, pricing discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Work closely with technical experts to support customer evaluations and deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with regulatory, marketing and technical colleagues on product registrations, approvals and market-access activities.
* Monitor customer needs, market trends, competitors and regulatory developments, and turn those insights into commercial opportunities.
* Maintain sales forecasts, opportunities, customer visit reports and relevant market intelligence through CRM and IBP processes.
* Represent LANXESS at relevant exhibitions, conferences, trade associations and technical seminars.
* Support new product introductions and take commercial projects from initial opportunity through to commercialisation.
* Travel regularly across the Middle East to meet customers, distributors and other business partners.

**Work Experience**
We are looking for someone early in their commercial career who combines business drive with an interest in technical products and customer applications.
  
  
**Ideally, You Have**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Food Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Chemical Engineering or another relevant discipline.
* Relevant B2B sales or business development experience. Because this is a junior position, we can consider profiles with approximately 1–2 years of experience, provided they have strong sector exposure or directly transferable experience.
* Commercial exposure to at least one relevant area, such as animal biosecurity, animal health, poultry, livestock, dairy, veterinary hygiene, food processing, beverage production, food safety, sanitation, hygiene/disinfection or related technical solutions.
* Experience working with relevant B2B customers, such as poultry integrators, dairy producers, livestock operations, food processors, distributors, veterinary professionals, or hygiene/quality teams, is highly relevant.
* Experience managing distributors, regional accounts, prospecting, or new-business development is an advantage.
* An understanding of disinfectants, hygiene solutions, speciality chemicals or related application technologies.
* Strong communication, relationship-building and commercial skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across an international organisation.
* Fluent English and Arabic for professional customer interaction.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the Middle East.

**Important Eligibility Requirement**
Candidates must already be living in Dubai and have the legal right to live and work in the UAE without requiring a new visa or work-permit sponsorship for this application.
  
  
**Benefits**
This opportunity lets you develop your sales career in a regional, customer-facing role covering the Middle East, working with an international speciality-chemicals business and a technically differentiated portfolio spanning animal biosecurity, hygiene, and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Gain exposure to a broad range of customers, distributors and industry stakeholders across the Middle East.
* Build experience across business development, technical selling, distributor management and regional account development.
* Work collaboratively with technical, regulatory and marketing specialists in an international organisation.
* Build market knowledge across animal biosecurity, food safety, sanitation, hygiene and related speciality applications.
* Develop a regional commercial network through customer visits, distributor collaboration and participation in industry events.

**A third-party employment provider will issue the employment contract, and you will work as an external employee supporting LANXESS.**
